ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Length per unit angle
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Length per angle of rotation

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Velocity squared
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The square of a velocity

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: API Neutron
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The Neutron calibration measurement determined using the API test pit. This quantity is associated with the natural formation hydrogen concentration.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Acceleration
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The rate of variation of velocity with time.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Amount Of Substance
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The amount of a particular substance (e.g. chemical) expressed in units of moles.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Area
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The two-dimensional extent of some region of interest.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Area Per Mass
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: An amount of surface corresponding to a unit mass.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Area Per Time
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity AreaPerTime, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Attenuation
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Loss in energy or reduction in sensitivity. In seismic work, loss in acoustic energy due to absorption, reflection, etc. which occurs between any two points of travel.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Capacitance
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the charge on a capacitor to the electric potential across it.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Conductance
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The readiness with which a material conducts electric current; the inverse of resistance. Also, the product of conductivity and thickness.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Conductivity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A measure of the quantity of electricity transferred across unit area per unit potential gradient per unit time. In isotropic material, it is the reciprocal of Resistivity. Sometimes called Specific Conductance.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Current Density
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Current per unit cross-sectional area.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity Dimensionless, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Electric Charge
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A definite quantity of electricity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Electric Current
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Flow of electric charge within an electromagnetic field, per unit time.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Electrical Potential
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A measure of Voltage

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Energy
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Capacity for doing work

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Flow Rate
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A measure of the volume of fluid flowing per unit time.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Force
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: An agency or influence that if applied to a free body results chiefly in an acceleration of the body and sometimes in elastic deformation and other effects.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Force Per Length
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Force per unit length

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Frequency
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The repetition rate of a periodic waveform. The inverse of period.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Illuminance
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The intensity of light striking a surface.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Inductance
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The capability of an electric circuit to induce an electromotive force (emf) within the circuit.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Length
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Linear extent of a measured distance or dimension.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Luminous Flux
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of visible-wavelength radiant energy, as measured from a point source and within a unit solid angle.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Luminous Intensity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The density of luminous flux per unit solid angle, measured in a given direction relative to the emitting source.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Magnetic Field Strength
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The force per unit magnetic pole (or current per unit length). Also called Magnetizing Force or Magnetic Intensity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Magnetic Flux
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The flux through a surface is the integral over the surface of the normal component of the magnetic induction.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Magnetic Inductance/Flux Density
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A vector quantity symbolized by B and given in terms of the force produced on a small element of length which is carrying an electric current. B relates to the magnetizing force by a constant called the Magnetic Permeability.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Mass
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The property of a body that is a measure of its inertia, that is commonly taken as a measure of the amount of material it contains, that causes a body to have weight in a gravitational field.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Mass Per Area Per Time
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity MassPerAreaPerTime, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Mass Per Time
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity MassPerTime, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Mass per Volume
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Base property for mass per volume

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Mobility
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The measure of the ease with which a fluid can be moved in a specific medium (i.e. rock). The ratio of the effective permeability and the viscosity of the fluid.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Plane Angle
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The angular displacement between two lines extending from the same point, measured in the plane of the two lines.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Power
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The time rate at which work is done or energy emitted or transferred.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Pressure
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The force or thrust exerted over a surface divided by its area; e.g., hydrostatic, flow, pump, etc. May be gauge or absolute.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Resistivity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The property of a material which resists the flow of electrical current. The ratio of electric-field intensity to current density. The reciprocal of conductivity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Temperature
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The degree of hotness or coldness measured on a definite scale

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Thermal Conductivity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Heat flux or thermal energy per unit length and temperature. The capacity of a body to conduct or pass thermal energy. The capacity of a material to conduct or pass thermal energy.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Time
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: 1) The measured or measurable period during which an action, process, or condition exists or continues. 2) The point or period when something occurs. 3) A fixed moment or hour for something to happen, begin, or end. 4) A historical period.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Velocity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The rate of change of the displacement of a body in time.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Volume
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A measure of the space occupied by a body in cubic units; e.g., cm3, in3, quarts, liters, etc.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Volume Per Mass
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity VolumePerMass, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Inverse Temperature
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity InverseTemperature, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Counterion Conductivity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The equivalent conductivity of the counterions (cations) in the diffuse layer around clay particles; ratio of conductivity to cation concentration. Refer to Waxman-Smits, Dual-Water models.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Energy per Mass
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Energy per mass, also called specific energy

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Extensive Heat Capacity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Heat capacity as extensive property in contrast to Specific_Heat_Capacity

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Extensive Heat Capacity per Temperature
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Extensive heat capacity per unit temperature, see Extensive_Heat_Capacity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Flow Rate per Pressure squared
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Root property for flow rate per pressure squared.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Molar Energy
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Energy per amount of substance

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Molar Heat Capacity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Heat capacity per amount of substance

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Molar Mass
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The mass of one mole of a substance

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Molar Volume
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The volume occupied by per mole of a substance at a given temperature and pressure.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Pressure Density
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Pressure multiplied by density - typically the product of an elastic modulus and density.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Specific Heat Capacity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: The amount of heat required to raise the temperature of a unit volume of a given material by a temperature interval.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Specific Heat Capacity per Temperature
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Specific heat capacity per unit temperature, see Specific_Heat_Capacity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Thermal Transmissibility
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Thermal transmissibility, thermal conductivity multiplied by length

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Volumetric Heat Capacity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Extensive heat capacity per volume, the ability of a given volume of a substance to store internal energy while undergoing a given temperature change, but without undergoing a phase change.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Volumetric Heat Capacity per Temperature
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Extensive heat capacity per volume and per temperature, see Volumetric_Heat_Capacity_Per_Temperature

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Pressure Per Flowrate
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Pressure Per Flowrate

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Pressure per Flowrate squared
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Pressure per flowrate per flowrate

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Inverse Temperature Squared
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Base unit quantity for inverse of temperature squared

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Inverse Area Squared
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Base property for inverse area squared

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Specific Heat Capacity per temperature cubed
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Specific heat capacity per unit temperature cubed, see Specific_Heat_Capacity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Specific Heat Capacity per temperature squared
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Specific heat capacity per unit temperature squared, see Specific_Heat_Capacity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Thermal Resistivity
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: A property of a material indicating its resistance to thermal conduction; an indication of a material's insulative quality. The reciprocal of Thermal_Conductivity.

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Filter Slope
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Base property for filter slope measurements

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Mass Per Volume Per Time
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Mass per volume per time

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Power Per Volume
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Power per volume

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Square Root Pressure
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Square root pressure

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Volume Per Mass Per Time
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Volume per mass per time

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Flowrate Per Pressure Per Length
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Flowrate Per Pressure Per Length

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Flowrate Per Pressure Per Pressure Per Length
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Flowrate Per Pressure Per Pressure Per Length

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Jones Gas Coeff A
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Jones Gas Coeff A

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Jones Gas Coeff B
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Jones Gas Coeff B

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Jones Liquid Coeff A
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Jones Liquid Coeff A

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Jones Liquid Coeff B
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Jones Liquid Coeff B

ListOfBaseMeasurements.Name: Power Gradient
ListOfBaseMeasurements.Description: Power per length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Penetration per Rotation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: It is usually used to describe the formation penetrated distance per dill bit rotation during drilling operation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Velocity Squared
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: WG: Ocean unit measurement for (m/sec)^2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gamma-Ray Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The intensity of natural gamma-ray radiation emitted from formations containing radioactive elements, such as Potassium, Thorium, and Uranium. Measured according to API specifications.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gamma Ray Minus Uranium
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measurement of the naturally occurring gamma radiation less the radiation attributed to uranium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Induced Gamma-Ray Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Intensity of gamma-ray radiation which has been induced, either chemically or by nuclear activation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Gamma Ray
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum value of Gamma Ray

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spatial Gamma Radiation Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Intensity of gamma radiation represented as a function of a spatial path.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spectral Gamma Radiation Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Intensity of gamma radiation represented as a function of wavelength.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Gravity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of hydrocarbon density equal to 141.5/(specific gravity @ 60 degF) - 131.5; usually reported with a temperature.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Low_Gravity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Low range of Gravity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: LowGravity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Low range of Gravity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gravitational Field Strength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Strength of the gravitational field at some location. Also referred to as the acceleration of gravity, measured in units of acceleration.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: X Gravity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Strength of the x-axis component of the gravitational field at some location.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Y Gravity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Strength of the y-axis component of the gravitational field at some location.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Z Gravity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Strength of the z-axis component of the gravitational field at some location; used to correct total z-axis acceleration of a logging tool to compute actual tool movement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Velocity Gradient In Time
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: First derivative of velocity versus time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: X Acceleration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Acceleration along the X-axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Y Acceleration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Acceleration along the Y-axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Z Acceleration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Acceleration along the Z-axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A property of rock (formation) denoting its ability to pass fluids through its interconnected pores. Permeability is estimated from measurements on well tests, cores, production results or logs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Absolute Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with a wetting fluid and without the influence of non-Darcy (turbulence) effects. Also called "intrinsic" permeability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Absolute Permeability - Gas
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with gas.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Absolute Permeability - Oil
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with oil.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Klinkenberg Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Empirical permeability measure derived by extrapolating the trend of gas permeability versus inverse pressure to infinite pressure (zero inverse pressure). The result is equivalent to the permeability which would be measured if the sample were 100% saturated with a non-reactive liquid and is sometimes called "liquid permeability" and abbreviated KL (where L is a subscript).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Absolute Permeability - Water
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Damaged Zone Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permeability of the near-wellbore Damaged Zone, the sandface layer around the wellbore where permeability and mobility are impaired, generally by a damaging material (e.g. completion or drill mud).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Crushed Zone Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permeability of the Crushed Zone around perforation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Directional Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An oriented permeability within a porous media, expressed either as horizontal (along the bedding plane of the stratum) or vertical (perpendicular to the bedding plane of the stratum), or within a coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Horizontal Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A permeability oriented horizontally along the bedding plane of the stratum. Usually abbreviated as Kx.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Axial Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permeability measured along the length of a core cylinder.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transverse Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permeability measured in the plane transverse to the length of the core cylinder. This may be represented as a single measurement in the flow plane or as a two component permeability represented as a measurement along an arbitrary diameter and another along an orthogonal path in the same plane.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spherical Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An effective permeability used to combine directional permeabilities, Kx and Ky. Usually abbreviated as Ksph.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A permeability oriented vertically perpendicular to the bedding plane of the stratum. Usually abbreviated as Ky.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: X Direction Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permeability in X Direction

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Y Direction Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permeability in Y Direction

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of the capacity of a single fluid to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock are not completely filled or saturated with the fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Gas
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of the capacity of gas to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock contain other fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Gas at Sor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective permeability to gas at residual oil saturation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Gas at Swi
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective permeability to gas at initial water saturation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Gas at Swr
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective permeability to gas at residual water saturation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Oil
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of the capacity of oil to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock contain other fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Oil at Swi
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective permeability to oil at initial water saturation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Water
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of the capacity of water to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock contain other fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Permeability to Water at Sor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective permeability to water at residual oil saturation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geometric Mean Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mean permeability in horizontal or vertical plane, computed as the square root of the product of the normal directional permeability values (e.g. X-Y or Y-Z) in the plane.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sqrt Kx Ky
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Geometric mean permeability in the horizontal plane (X-Y) of the reservoir.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sqrt Ky Kz
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Geometric mean permeability in the vertical plane (Y-Z) of the reservoir

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formation permeability as measured with an nuclear magnetic logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average permeability in the net pay portion of the zone interval (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Core Permeability (PM)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average permeability in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from core data by point-match method.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Log Permeability (PM)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average permeability in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum value of Permeability

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average permeability in the net reservoir portion of the zone interval (thickness weighted arithmetic/geometric/harmonic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Per Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of volume per linear displacement, usually given in bbl/in, bbl/ft, U.S. gal/ft.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Filtrate Volume
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of volume of mud filtrate lost to the formation per linear length of borehole, usually given in U.S. gal/ft.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas production volume per length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized gas cumulative per lateral length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized gas cumulative per perforation length per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized gas cumulative per perforation length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Production Volume Per Length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized liquid cumulative per lateral length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized liquid cumulative per perforation length per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Production Volume Per Perforation Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized liquid cumulative per perforation length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Production Volume Per Lateral Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized oil cumulative per lateral length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Production Volume Per Lateral Length Per No Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized oil cumulative per lateral length per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Production Volume Per Perflength Per No Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized oil cumulative per perforation length per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Production Volume Per Perforation Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized oil cumulative per perforation length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Production Volume Per Lateral Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized water  cumulative per lateral length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Production Volume Per Lateral Length Per No Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized water  cumulative per lateral length per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Production Volume Per Perflength Per No Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized water  cumulative per perforation length per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Production Volume Per Perforation Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized water  cumulative per perforation length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the two-dimensional extent of the surface of some object.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Flow Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total cross-sectional area through which fluid can flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductive Inclusion Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average area of conductive inclusions as seen at the borehole wall

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cross-sectional Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The cross-sectional area of anobject; e.g., area of perforation in a cased borehole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pipe Cross Sectional Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cross sectional area of a pipe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drainage Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The drainage area of a reservoir.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gross Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gross area of a region such as that of a lease parcel or covered by a lease agreement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resistive Inclusion Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average area of resistive inclusions as seen at the borehole wall

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Area Per Mass
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Added for Epicentre compatibility 29-May-95

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Specific Surface Area (mass-based)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characteristic of a porous media which is the internal surface area of the medium per unit mass.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Area Per Time
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formerly called FlowratePerLength

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Diffusion Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: In nuclear magnetic resonance analysis, the measure of the ability of the molecule containing the polarized proton to diffuse (or move) through a medium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: This is a copy of the unit quantity FlowratePerLength, which acts as the parent for other SDM_Property instances

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flowrate Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the change in the flowrate of a fluid per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Diffusivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the tendency for diffusion to occur. See Hydraulic_Diffusivity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thermal Diffusivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the rate at which heat is conducted through a medium. Typical value for rock material is ~.01 cm2/s.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydraulic Diffusivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characteristic of a rock-fluid system that describes the relationship of pressure change in time to pressure gradient. It is defined as permeability divided by the product of porosity, fluid viscosity and fluid compressibility.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Layer Diffusivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diffusivity (permeability divided by the product of porosity, fluid viscosity and fluid compressibility) for a reservoir layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Kinematic Viscosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The dynamic viscosity of a fluid divided by the density of the fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Optical Power Margin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The difference between the optical power that is launched by a given transmitter into the fiber and the minimum optical power that is required by the receiver for a specified level of performance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Attenuation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amount of reduction in the amplitude of an acoustic wave.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of two amplitude values.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gain
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An increase in amplitude or power from one point in a system to another, such as between input and output.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Noise/Signal Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of noise amplitude to signal amplitude, usually expressed in dB. Note: the inverse, Signal_To_Noise_Ratio, is preferred and should be used whenever possible.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reflection Strength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude of analytical seismic trace (Hilbert transform technique). Synonym of Instantaneous_Amplitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Response Strength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Reflection strength at local maximum of reflection intensity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Signal/Noise Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of signal amplitude to noise amplitude, usually expressed in dB.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Decibel_Per_Meter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Decible Per Meter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: DecibelPerMeter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Decible Per Meter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Attenuation Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the rate of attenuation of a wave per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electromagnetic Attenuation Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the rate of attenuation of an electromagnetic wave per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Attenuation Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the rate of attenuation of an acoustic wave per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Wave Differential Energy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The change in attenuation of an acoustic wave (compressional, shear or Stoneley) per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Permittivity/Capacitivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The property of a material that enables it to store electrical charge, typically measured in farad/m. Free space has a Permittivity of 8.854E-12 farad/m.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Admittance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The reciprocal of Impedance. The property of a medium to allow for the flow of an alternating current.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Array Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formation conductivity as measured by a device capable of taking measurements at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation, azimuth; such surveys allow detailed investigation of the invasion profile.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Array InductionConductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formation conductivity as measured by an induction device capable of taking measurements at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation, azimuth; such surveys allow detailed investigation of the invasion profile.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Array Laterolog Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formation conductivity as measured by a laterolog device capable of taking measurements at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation, azimuth; such surveys allow detailed investigation of the invasion profile.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bound Water Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity of water bound to clay in the formations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Deep Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Deep Induction Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, measured by an induction log, which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Deep Laterolog Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formation Conductivity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity of a fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity of the zone immediately behind the mudcake and which is considered to be flushed by mud filtrate, i.e., it is considered to have all mobile formation fluids displaced from it.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Medium Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contain fluids which are a mixture of mud filtrate, connate water and possibly hydrocarbons.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Medium Induction Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, made by an induction log, which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Medium Laterolog Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Micro Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measurement of the conductivity of the formation within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Micro Laterolog Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measurement of the conductivity of the formation, by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Micro Spherically Focused Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measurement of the conductivity of the formation, by a spherically focused tool, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mineral Conductivity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductivity Profile
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity profile measurement, used primarily for pattern recognition; may or may not be calibrated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shallow Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shallow Induction Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, measured by an induction log, which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shallow Laterolog Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spherically Focused Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The conductivity, measured by a spherically focused log, which represents the resistivity approximately one to two feet into the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity of Connate Water (in formation)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sonde Error
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An unwanted portion of the total conductivity measurement of an induction logging instrument, generated by imperfections in the coils in the sonde. It is measured during surface calibration and then cancelled during the survey operation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the change in the density of a material per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Remaining Life
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Remaining relative life predicted by the CoilLIFE model expressed as a percentage

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Photoelectric Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the probability that scattering due the Photoelectric Effect will occur; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Filter Cake Photoelectric Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Photoelectric Factor of the filter cake (mudcake); often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Matrix Photoelectric Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Photoelectric Factor of the matrix (zero-porosity rock) or pure material; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction or percentage of the pore volume occupied by a specific fluid; e.g., oil, gas, water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Saturation at Breakthrough
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water saturation at the breakthough point. In Special Core Analysis, breakthough is the appearance of the injected fluid at the outlet face of the rock sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Saturation at Breakthrough (Fractional Flow)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water saturation at the breakthough point, calculated from fractional flow curve (SCAL SwBkFF). In Special Core Analysis, breakthough is the appearance of the injected fluid at the outlet face of the rock sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Saturation at Min So - 3Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The water saturation at minimum oil saturation in a three phase system. (SCAL SWM)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Initial Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water Saturation at the beginning of the test, experiment or production.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum value of Water Saturation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average water saturation in the net pay portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Core Water Saturation (PM)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average water saturation in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from core data by point-match method.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Log Water Saturation (PM)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average water saturation in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average water saturation in the net reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Hydrocarbon Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains hydrocarbons.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Fluid Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bound Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains bound water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Bound Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains bound water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Critical Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The value of saturation of a specific fluid phase at which the fluid will first begin to flow as saturation is increased.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Critical Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The highest water saturation a hydrocarbon-producing rock can maintain before water will begin to flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Critical Gas Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The value of gas saturation at which gas will begin to flow, as gas saturation is increased.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Critical Oil Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The value of oil saturation at which oil will begin to flow, as oil saturation is increased.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Oil-Based Mud Filtrate Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains oil based mud filtrate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Flushed Zone Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average flushed zone water saturation in the net pay portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Flushed Zone Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average flushed zone water saturation in the net reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains gas.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Saturation at Breakthrough
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas saturation at the breakthrough point. In Special Core Analysis, breakthrough is the appearance of the injected fluid at the outlet face of the rock sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Saturation at Min So - 3Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The gas saturation at minimum oil saturation in a three phase system. (SCAL SGM)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Initial Gas Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas Saturation at the beginning of the test, experiment or production.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrocarbon Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction of pore volume filled with hydrocarbons.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Irreducible Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction of the pore volume occupied by water in a reservoir at maximum hydrocarbon saturation, such that it cannot be further reduced.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction of the total pore volume in a formation or rock sample occupied by liquid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mercury Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction of the total pore volume in a rock sample occupied by mercury (special core analysis)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains oil.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Initial Oil Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Oil Saturation at the beginning of the test, experiment or production.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Min Oil Saturation - 3Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum oil saturation in a 3 phase system. (SCAL SORM)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Residual Gas Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction or percentage of gas remaining following production from the reservoir.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Residual Hydrocarbon Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction or percentage of hydrocarbons remaining following the production of hydrocarbons from the reservoir.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Residual Oil Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction or percentage of oil remaining following the liberation of gases from the reservoir.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Residual Water Saturation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction or percentage of water remaining at maximum hydrocarbon saturation, as measured in core analysis. It differs from Irreducible_Water_Saturation because of filtrate invasion and gas expansion from the core being brought to the surface.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volumetric Photoelectric Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A lithology indicator computed from bulk density and Photoelectric Factor; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/cc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: U-Matrix
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Matrix identification indicator computed from bulk density and Photoelectric Factor; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/cc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Elemental Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fractional contribution of an element to the total; in induced gamma-ray spectroscopy, it is the fraction of the counts in the measured spectrum due to a given element.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Aluminum Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Aluminum with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calcium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Calcium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Barium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Barium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Boron Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Boron with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Carbon Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Carbon with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chlorine Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Chlorine with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Copper Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Copper with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluorine Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Fluorine with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gadolinium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Gadolinium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrogen Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Hydrogen with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Iron Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Iron with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lead Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Lead with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Manganese Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Manganese with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Magnesium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Magnesium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Potassium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Potassium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nickel Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Nickel with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nitrogen Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Nitrogen with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oxygen Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Oxygen with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Phosphorus Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Phosphorus with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Samarium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Samarium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Silicon Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Silicon with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sodium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Sodium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Strontium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Strontium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sulfur Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Sulfur with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thorium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Thorium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Uranium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Uranium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Titanium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Titanium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zinc Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Zinc with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zirconium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Zirconium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chromium Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Chromium with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cobalt Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Cobalt with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Molybdenum Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Molybdenum with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tool Background Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Tool Background with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Detector Background Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Detector Background with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sodium Chloride Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Sodium Chloride with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Potassium Chloride Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Potassium Chloride with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chromium Nickel Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elemental contribution of Chromium Nickel with respect to total.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mass_Ratio_Percent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of mass ratio

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: MassRatioPercent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of mass ratio

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Address
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location where some entity or information may be found or contacted.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: E-mail Address
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Address used for electronic mail, such as an Internet address (clinton@white_house.gov)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Postal Address
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Location to which postal correspondence may be sent for a person, business or other entity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Phone Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Telephone number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Alternate Phone Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Alternate phone number, including country code.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fax Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Telephone number used for FAX (facsimile) transmission and/or reception.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Street Address
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Physical location of a business, residence, or other installation, as would be used by a courier service or visitor to locate the installation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Universal Resource Locator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Address of Worldwide Web site; acronym for Universal Resource Locator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Adsorption
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The adhesion in an extremely thin layer of molecules (as of gases, solutes, or liquids) to the surfaces of solid bodies or liquids with which they are in contact

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Quantity, total number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Absolute Abundance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Quantity of members in a group, as expressed as a count and count units, such as 5 sacks, 3 boxes, or 4 items.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Initial Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Initial amount. Usually used to quantify the initial amount of some material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mass Spectrum Abundance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The abundances of the molecular constituents of a material; may be represented as voltage of a flame ionization detector, amount relative to a standard solution or actual mass quantities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum Quantity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum quantity, number of items.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Package Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Quantity of material contained in each package. Unit depends upon the type of material and packaging.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent or range of a property; especially, the maximum departure of a wave from its average value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Difference
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude difference between two interpretations. Usually, one interpretation is hand-picked and the other one snapped or smoothed (i.e. a slight modification of the first one).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Estimate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude value on one side of an intersection

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average (mean) value of amplitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Peak Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average of the amplitudes of waveform peaks.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Avg Trough Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average of the amplitudes of waveform troughs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Echo Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amplitude of an echo signal.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Trace
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of an instantaneous attribute over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Apparent Seismic Polarity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of the Apparent Polarity trace over a given interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Cosine Of Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of the Cosine Of Phase trace over a given interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Instantaneous Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of the Instantaneous Frequency trace over a given interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Reflection Strength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of the Reflection Strength trace over a given interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Seismic Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of the Seismic Amplitude trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Seismic Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The integral of the absolute value of the Seismic Amplitude trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Longitudinal Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude of the longitudinal component in multi-component seismic.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum value of amplitude

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Trace min amplitude

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Post-Cursor Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Difference in seismic amplitude between a reference position and the corresponding deeper extreme.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pre-Cursor Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Difference in seismic amplitude between a reference position and the corresponding shallower extreme.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Noise Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amplitude of noise or unwanted portion of a signal.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Peak Peak Delta Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude difference between two peaks.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Peak Trough Delta Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude difference between peak and trough.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reflection Heterogeneity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indirect measure of how much a reflection signal is changing or of how erratic a trace is. A constant has a Reflection_Heterogeneity of 0. Heterogeneity can be computed from any of several signals, including seismic data, instantaneous phase, instantaneous frequency, apparent polarity and reflection strength.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heterogeneity Cosine Of Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Cosine of Phase trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heterogeneity Instantaneous Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Instantaneous Frequency trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heterogeneity Instantaneous Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Instantaneous Phase trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heterogeneity Reflection Strength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Reflection Strength trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heterogeneity Seismic Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Seismic Amplitude trace over a given interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: RMS Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Root Mean Square of amplitudes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rover Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Difference between seismic amplitude and the straight line connecting the two nearest extremes (with same kick).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Signal Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amplitude associated with a generic type signal.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sum Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sum of the amplitudes

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sum Negative Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sum of amplitudes less than zero.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sum Positive Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sum of amplitudes greater than zero.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transverse Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude of transverse component in multi-component seismic.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trough Peak Delta Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude difference between trough and peak.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trough Trough Delta Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude difference between two troughs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Reflection Spectrum
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume Reflection Spectrum, i.e. spectral decomposition of the amplitude response in interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multi-Component Transverse X
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: X component of Transverse_Amplitude in multi-component seismic.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multi-Component Transverse Y
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Y component of Transverse_Amplitude in multi-component seismic.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multi-Component Transverse Z
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Z component of Transverse_Amplitude in multi-component seismic.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the maximum departure of an acoustic wave from the average value

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Analytic Trace
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Complex seismic trace resulting from combination of input trace and its Hilbert transform. Normally represented as a pair of floating point numbers. [GeoFrame Value type: Complex32_t]

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Apparent Polarity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sign of trace sample scaled with Reflection_Strength; used for seismic displays.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cosine Of Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cosine of Instantaneous Phase, also known as normalized seismic amplitude

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Instantaneous Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude component of an analytic seismic trace, when decomposed into amplitude and phase components (absolute value).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CBL Amplitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of acoustic wave amplitude used for cement bond evaluation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Corridor Stack
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A summation of the traces in an upgoing Vertical Seismic Profile that have been processed to retain only primary reflection events and that have been time-shifted to their two-way arrival times at the surface. Summation is over a data window (corridor) beginning at the first break time and usually ending 200-300 ms later.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Seismic Arc Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of reflection heterogeneity which is used to quantify lateral changes in reflection patterns. Used as a stratigraphic sequence indicator.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude-Phase(Complex)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Signal Amplitude and Phase represented as a complex number in polar coordinates, in the form Ae^jP. The first component A is the amplitude; the second component P is the phase in degrees.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Anisotropy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the variation of a property based upon the direction in which it is measured.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bale Kappa
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bale's kappa, the mode-converted wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout mode-converted wave velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Bale Kappa
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Bale's kappa, the mode-converted wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout Converted wave velocities, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Bale Kappa
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Bale's kappa, the mode-converted wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout mode-converted wave velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bale Xi
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bale's xi, the shear wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout shear wave velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Bale Xi

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Bale Xi
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Bale's xi, the shear wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout shear wave velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thomsen Delta
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Thomsen's delta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and moveout Compressional velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Thomsen Delta
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's delta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and moveout Compressional velocities, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Thomsen Delta
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's delta anisotropy parameter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thomsen Epsilon
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Thomsen's epsilon anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and horizontal Compressional velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Thomsen Epsilon
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's epsilon anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and horizontal Compressional velocities, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Thomsen Epsilon
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's epsilon anisotropy parameter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thomsen Gamma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Thomsen's gamma anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between Horizontally polarized Shear (SH) velocities in the vertical and horizontal directions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Thomsen Gamma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's gamma anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between Horizontally polarized Shear (SH) velocities in the vertical and horizontal directions, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Thomsen Gamma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's gamma anisotropy parameter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thomsen Sigma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Thomsen's sigma anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between Vertically polarized Shear (SV) velocities in the vertical direction and moveout SV velocity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Thomsen Sigma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's sigma anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between Vertically polarized Shear (SV) velocities in the vertical direction and moveout SV velocity, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Thomsen Sigma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's sigma anisotropy parameter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Permittivity Anisotropy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Permittivity Anisotropy Ratio

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Alkhalifah Eta
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Alkhalifah's eta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout Compressional velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Alkhalifah Eta
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Alkhalifah's eta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout Compressional velocities, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Alkhalifah Eta

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Annotation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Any annotation (or annotations) pertaining to an object. For example, annotations attached to a Map object.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Intrinsic Safety Certification Marking
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mark made on an equipment item defining the type of intrinsic certification. Typical marking includes certifying authority symbol, type of protection, protection group for electrical apparatus and temperature class, e.g., "EEx ia I T5": CENELEC Intrinsic Safety-2 faults Methane 100 degree C.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Parameter Label
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: String carrying the short explanation of a parameter, for use in user interface

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Atomic Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An experimentally determined number characteristic of a chemical element that represents the number of protons in the nucleus which in a neutral atom equals the number of electrons outside of the nucleus and that determines the place of the element in the periodic table.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Atomic Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The average relative weight of an element referred to some element taken as a standard; basis may be hydrogen with an atomic weight of 1, oxygen with an atomic weight of 16, or carbon with an atomic weight of 12.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Design
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The API design specification that the equipment meets

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Range
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: API range characteristic for length of tubular goods

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: ASAP Depth Parameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Private structure used by the ASAP autotracking application; holds depth variations of time-domain Property ASAP_Parameter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: ASAP Parameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Private structure used by the ASAP autotracking application.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Background Pressure Trend
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Background pressure trend for a horizontal interference test

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Beaufort Scale Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The Beaufort wind scale is a system used to estimate and report wind speeds when no measuring apparatus is available. It was invented in the early 19th century by Admiral Sir Francis Beaufort of the British Navy as a way to interpret winds from conditions at sea, e.g. 5 on the Beaufort scale corresponds to a wind of 17-21 knots and is defined as "Fresh Breeze: Moderate waves (1.8m), many white horses."

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The code, mnemonic, or identifier used to enumerate types, occurrences, or instances of some property or entity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Currency

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Head Code

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of a geodetic coordinate system. This property specifies whether the Geodetic coordinate system used to record position data is Cartesian or Latitude/Longitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A number which serves as a measure of some characteristic of a process, substance or device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Decimation Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number indicating the degree of data reduction from decimation (resampling at lower sampling frequency); e.g. a Decimation_Factor of 5 indicates that only every 5th input sample is retained as output.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Correction Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient used to correct data, such as for environmental effects.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Crossflow Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Characterization of the flow in the reservoir from one layer to another layer, usually known as "Omega" in Reservoir Dynamics

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Detection Gain
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient used to adjust signal amplitude for detection of some event, such as the first arrival in a sonic waveform.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Deviation Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dimensionless quantity expressing how a gas deviates from perfect gas law, commonly expressed by PV=ZnRT. Sometimes named Gas Compressibility Factor, but NOT the same as Gas_Compressibility. Z usually varies from 0.7 to 1.2.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: FCVF Inertial Flow Correlation Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cooke's inertial fracture flow correlation coefficient (b). Empirical coefficient relating Fracture inertial flow coefficient Beta to Fracture permeability. Non RP66 Unit

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: J Function Coefficients
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficients used in the J function, a function used to normalize capillary pressure to account for differences in permeability, porosity, and fluid systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Klinkenberg Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Empirical conversion factor used to estimate Klinkenberg permeability from measured gas permeability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Longitudinal Dispersivity Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A coefficient used as a multiplier of interstitial velocity to estimate dispersion in the direction of movement for a displacement front in permeable media.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Latitude Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient for a latitude term in a multiple regression equation for computing geodetic datum shifts.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Latitude Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient for a longitude term in a multiple regression equation for computing geodetic datum shifts.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NRM factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: NRM factor

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Noise Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Noise coefficient of pressure sensor

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Normalization Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient used to normalize data for comparison or correlation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Kr Function Coefficients
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficients used in the function.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sayers Anellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sayers' normalized anellipticity factor, an alternative to eta for describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout compressional velocities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Sayers Anellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Sayers' normalized anellipticity factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Sayers Anellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Sayers' normalized anellipticity factor an alternative to eta for describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout compressional velocities, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Scale Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient used to convert or correct data, as to some standard.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Scale X
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scale factor in X dimension

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Scale Y
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scale factor in Y dimension

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Scale Z
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scale factor in Z dimension

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geocentric Scale Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scale factor used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geocentric Scale Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scale factor used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Map Scale Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the scale along the meridian or along the parallel at a given point to the scale at some map point or along some line; each point on the map has a distinct value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Scale Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scale Factor which is used as a defining parameter for a projection, typically taken along the Central Meridian or along one of the major parallels

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Scale Reduction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A number by which the scale along a designated meridian, great circle, or parallel is reduced or enlarged during the projection process to reduce the scale error elsewhere in the projection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Schoenberg Ellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Schoenberg's ellipticity factor, the ratio of horizontal to vertical velocity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Schoenberg Ellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of Schoenberg's ellipticity factor, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Schoenberg Ellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Schoenberg's ellipticity factor, for each layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Geometric Spreading
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The total effect of geometric spreading along ray. Factor giving the reduction in seismic amplitude (<1) due to spreading of the wave between two points. Includes both spherical divergence and cylindrical divergence.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transverse Dispersivity Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The coefficient used as a multiplier of interstitial velocity to estimate dispersion normal to the direction of movement for a displacement front.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transverse Isotropy Coefficients
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The degree of transverse isotropy in a medium; that is, having the different property values when measured within or normal to a plane. Usually represented by the 5 coefficients of the Stiffness matrix: C11, C13, C33, C44, C66.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Z Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The factor which corrects for the deviation of a gas from the ideal gas law when calculating PVT relationships.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Affine Coefficient A
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient "A" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Affine Coefficient B
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient "B" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Affine Coefficient C
