ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient "C" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Affine Coefficient D
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient "D" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Affine Coefficient E
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient "E" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Affine Coefficient F
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient "F" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Sequence Trend
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A coefficient that characterizes the upwards or downwards increasing conductivity trend within a given depth interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pc Function Coefficients
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficients used in the capillary pressure function.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Biot Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The proportion of fluid pressure in a material which acts to counterbalance overburden pressure. Used in the calculation of net overburden: P_eff = P_overburden - (Biot_Coefficient * P_fluid).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: k
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The k parameter in the Power-Law and Herschel-Bulkley rheological models. The Power_Law model is "Shear_Stress=k times (Shear_Rate at the power of n)". The unit of k is traditionally lbf.sec^n/ft^2 or Pa.s^n.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coherence
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the similarity between two or more functions; used with seismic waveforms to distinguish seismic events and to implement automatic picking schemes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Semblance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of waveform coherence with respect to slowness and time, computed as a function of coherent energy to total energy; also called "Slowness_Time_Coherence"

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Slowness-Time Coherence
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of waveform coherence with respect to slowness and time, computed as a function of coherent energy to total energy; also called "Semblance"

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Color
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The aspect of objects and light sources that may be described in terms of hue, lightness, and saturation for objects and hue, brightness, and saturation for light sources.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Color Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A descriptive remark with respect to the distribution of a color within the area of a rock surface; e.g. solid, spotty, streaky.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Color in Fluorescent Light
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The color emitted by the fluid upon exposure to fluorescent light. Certain photoactive hydrocarbon molecules display characteristic color patterns under these conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Color Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A descriptive comment with respect to the intensity of color; e.g. bright, dull, powdery.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Color Map
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of entity which maps from Implementation index values to color; GPD_COLOR_MAP arrays are commonly used.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Color in Normal Light
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The color of a hydrocarbon show under normal incident light.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lithologic Color
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characteristic color of a lithologic sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spore Color Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Relative color of fossil spores as caused by thermal processes. Index is used as an indicator of thermal maturation of organic material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Companion Data
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Collection to hold miscellaneous competitor data in any form (parameters, arrays, ...), not described in the Data Model

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Mask
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Data pattern which allows storage and access of several types of independent data within a simple representation; common masks use individual bits of integer representations, or individual characters of string representations, to carry independent information.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Operation Mask
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mask for the drilling operating mode, such as 0001 - Rotating, 0010 - Sliding, 0100 - Reaming, 1000 - Trip in, 10000 - Trip out

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Snap Criteria
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Set of parameters used by an application for "snapping" interpretation values to their corresponding data samples

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: User Data Ident
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: User-defined mask

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: User Evaluation Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Auxiliary user-defined mask

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Computation Mask
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Application-specific mask for the computation options (one Anadrill example: 0001 - Torque & Drag, 0010 - BHA Tendency, 0100 - Bit Side Forces, 1000 - Buckling, 10000 - Yield Stress)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The relative content of a component; e.g., the concentration of salts in brackish water, the concentration of electric charges in a circuit, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Concentration 1
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration or proportion of first component in mixture or other composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 1
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of first component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 1
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of first component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Concentration 2
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration or proportion of second component in mixture or other composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 2
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of second component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 2
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of second component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Concentration 3
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration or proportion of third component in mixture or other composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 3
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of third component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 3
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of third component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Concentration 4
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration or proportion of fourth component in mixture or other composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 4
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of fourth component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Concentration 4
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of fourth component

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gel Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of gelled fluid (fracturing gel, gelled acid ...)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: H2S Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of H2S generally measured in ppm. H2S concentration is critical in evaluating the corrosion of metal (e.g. coiled tubing) under stresses.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lime Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Lime content in water based mud as determined per API RP13P Section 8

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Loss On Ignition
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Proportion by weight of a sample which remains after the sample has been heated (e.g. 1000 degC) in an oxygen atmosphere and the volatile oxides evaporated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Loss On Ignition (H2O+)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volatile Hydrogen component of Loss On Ignition, sometimes abbreviated H2O+.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nitrogen Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Nitrogen

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mole Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the number of moles of a component to the total number of moles present.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Percent of Nitrogen
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mole fraction of Nitrogen to total gas composition

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Percent of Carbon Dioxide
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mole fraction of Carbon Dioxide to total gas composition

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Percent of Hydrogen Sulfide
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mole fraction of Hydrogen Sulfide to total gas composition

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Percent of Hydrogen
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mole fraction of Hydrogen to total gas composition

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Chloride Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of chlorides in mud.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Nitrate Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of nitrates in mud.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Potassium Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Potassium by weight.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: K+
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Potassium K+ cation concentration

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Polyol Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Polyol Concentration per fluid Volume (Polyol are glycol-glycerol alcohol derivatives)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Salinity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of the total salts in solution (Na, K, Cl, So4, ..).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Salinity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total salts in solution (Na, K, Cl, So4, ..). Normal sea water has around 35,000 ppm (parts per million) salinity. Less than 2,000 ppm is considered "fresh".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bound Water Salinity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Salinity of the water bound to clays in the formation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Borehole Salinity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Salinity of the fluid in the borehole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Filtrate Salinity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Salinity of mud filtrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Solids Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Solid Concentration (Cutting, clays, polymer) per fluid Volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: High Gravity Solid Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: High gravity solids Concentration

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Low Gravity Solid Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Low gravity solid Concentration

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sand Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sand content per Mud Volume, API RP13B, Section 5, Sand

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thorium Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Thorium by weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Uranium Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Uranium by weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: iso-Butane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of iso-Butane (i-C4H10); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.3%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: iso-Pentane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of iso-Pentane (i-C5H12); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.3%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: iso-Hexane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of iso-Hexane (i-C6H14).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Normal Butane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Normal Butane (n-C4H10); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.6%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Normal Pentane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Normal Pentane (n-C5H12); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.25%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Normal Hexane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Normal Hexane (n-C6H14).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: pH
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of the degree of acidity or basicity of an aqueous solution. A value of 7 denotes a neutral fluid, lower values correspond to acidic fluids and higher values to basic fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio between fluid additive and fluid volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acid Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of acid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Alkalinity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of basic anions in an aqueous solution (e.g. OH-, CO3-- and HC03-)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mf
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume ratio of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid (Mf_Titration_Volume) including that amount required for the Pf endpoint (Pf_Titration_Volume) to mud filtrate, API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pf
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume ratio of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid (Pf_Titration_Volume) to mud filtrate volume, API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pm
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume ratio of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid (Pm_Titration_Volume) to mud volume in API Mud Phenolphthalein Alkalinity test (API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Aluminum Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Aluminum by weight.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ethane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of C2H6 by volume. Typical value in natural gas 6%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Propane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Propane (C3H8); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 2%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Butane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Butane (C4H10).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pentane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Pentane (n-C5H12).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hexane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Hexane (C6H14); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.3%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heptane Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Heptane (C7H16)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heptane-Plus Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Heptane and hydrocarbons heavier than Heptane; typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.5%

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CH4 Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Methane (CH4); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 85%.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CO2 Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Carbon Dioxide (CO2)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CO Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Carbon Monoxide (CO)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cesium Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Cesium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chloride Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of chloride ions in water based mud or in the water phase of oil based bud

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cobalt Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Concentration of Cobalt.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Correction applicable to a measurement, to remove environmental effects or measurement errors; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: KB Receiver Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Correction vector to receiver position relative to Kelly Bushing

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: KB Source Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Correction vector to source position relative to Kelly Bushing

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: MSL Receiver Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Correction vector to receiver position relative to Mean Sea Level.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: MSL Source Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Correction vector to source position relative to Mean Sea Level.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Receiver Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal correction vector to receiver position

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Source Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal correction vector to source position

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Porosity Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Correction to a Porosity measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Correction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude correction applied to one side of an intersection

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A number indicating the number of occurrences of something.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Dimensions
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of dimensions for an object or a representation of such an object, e.g. dimensions of an array.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Elements
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of elements, usually in an array or along an axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mute Taper Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of samples muted in the traces

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Elements
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum number of elements in a group or collection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Element Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum number of elements in a group or collection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CDP Fold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of traces stacked at a CDP.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gauge Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of gauges

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Horizon Sample Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of horizon samples to use while smoothing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interpretation Grid Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of Interpretation grids that exist for the horizon.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Job Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of jobs performed or included.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Joints
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of joints of tubular goods.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Levels
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of levels in a sequence or portion of a sequence, such as in a hierarchy.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Material Addition Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of packaging units of chemicals added to the drilling fluid. (e.g., Add 5 sacks of Barite C100 100lb/sack to the drilling fluid)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Data Set Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum number of Data Set

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Gauge Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum number of Gauges possible with this type of Equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Sequence Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum Sequence Count

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Station Increment
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal increment in station number for consecutive stations

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Non-Zero Samples
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of samples that do not have a value of zero.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nozzle Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of nozzles in an equipment item, such as a drill bit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Perforation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total number of perforations over the perforated interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Personnel Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Headcount of personnel satisfying role of Personnel_Role; these may be implemented as lists.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Personnel On Board
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Count of number of people on board the vessel or structure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of plungers
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of plungers e.g. 3 for a triplex pump.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Population
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A count of the number of persons or objects.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Port Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of ports, such as in a Coiled Tubing BHA

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: QHSE Report Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of QHSE reports issued for the reporting period

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Receiver Groups
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total number of receiver groups attached to the cable

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Rotor Lobes
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of rotor lobes in a drill motor configuration (PDM only). Note: Stator is equal to rotor plus one.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sample Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of samples.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of screens
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of Screens

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Simulation Multiple Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of multiple reflections considered in the simulation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cone Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of cones of a solid Control Equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stroke Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cumulative number of strokes over a time interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Summed Traces Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of traces in stack

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Stages
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of stages in an activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trace Count Receiver
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The maximum number of traces which were recorded at any individual receiver for all source events

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trace Count Source
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The maximum number of traces assigned to the source

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number Of Wells
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The count of the numbers of wells.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of jobs
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total Number of jobs

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zero Crossings
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Count of zero crossings of waveform(s).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of acid jobs
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of acid jobs

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Byte Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total number of bytes used or required by a collection of data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Record Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total record length in bytes, such as for a seismic trace header.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: ADS Blocking Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Blocking factor for the Array Data Server

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Bores
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of bores, as in a production packer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Burner Head Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of heads of the burner (conventionally, 3,4 or 6)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cardinality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of instances of an Entity type which may be referred to by another Entity in a particular relationship; may be ONE or MANY.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cell Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of cells

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Centralizer Count Per Joint
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of centralizers per joint, e.g. 2 per joint.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Compartment Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of independent storage units

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number Of Completions
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The count of the number of completions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Cutters
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of cutters, as for drilling hole openers and reamers.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cycle Sample Count
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Target number of samples per hour.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Number of Core Boxes
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of core boxes containing samples from a cored borehole interval in a particular well.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Depth Dip
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dip computed on a depth surface by measuring the difference in depths between two points compared to the horizontal distance between the points.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Correlation Depth Dip
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dip of seismic data, similar to Depth_Dip but gradient derived from the seismic data (in depth)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The description or complete definition of any data item or object

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Diameter Restriction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of the change in diameter within a well or a borehole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formula
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Symbolic expression of a rule or principle.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chemical Formula
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A symbolic expression of the composition or constitution of a substance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: General Weather Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of current weather conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Grain Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Textual description of the grain distribution in a rock sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Legal Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Legal description associated with a legal document or agreement, for instance, a description of the boundaries of a lease.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lithology
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Textual description of the lithology.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Occurrence
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of where an object, material or phenomenon may occur or be found.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resolution Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Textual description of the qualified resolution, e.g., 0.005 psi at > 4 s sampling rate, 0.01 psi at 1 s sampling rate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Show Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A textual description of the hydrocarbon shows in a rock sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Show Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A textual description of the distribution of hydrocarbon indicators on a rock surface; e.g. solid, spotty, streaky.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Show Flow Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A textual description of the rate at which fluid emerges from the rock sample. Example keywords include: dead oil, live show, streaming or bleeding.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Show Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A qualitative indicator of the intensity of the fluid show.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spot Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fractional part of interest within the section

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Text
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Textual body a document or document section, such as a contract clause.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trace Elements
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of the trace elements in a sample or material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Accuracy Description
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Textual description of the data related to accuracy.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Daily Prognosis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of activities and events anticipated during the next 24 hours.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Definition
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A full textual description of the meaning of a term.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dielectric Constant
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the Permittivity of a material to that of free space.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Borehole Radius
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dimensionless Borehole Radius ("rwD")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Boundary Distance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distance to a boundary divided by wellbore radius

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Changing Storage Pressure
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dimensionless changing wellbore storage pressure ("CphiD")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Fracture Conductivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of fracture conductivity (fracture permeability x average width) to the (matrix permeability x fracture half_length) product. Standard industry acronym : "FCD", S.P.E. preferred form "CfD".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Interwell Distance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dimensionless inter-well distance for a horizontal interference test

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Layer Diffusivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of layer storativity ratio to layer transmissibility ratio ("etaDj")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Rectangle Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rectangle length divided by reference length ("BxD")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Rectangle Width
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rectangle width divided by reference length ("ByD")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Well X Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Well position expressed as fraction of rectangle length ("xbx")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dimensionless Well Y Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Well position expressed as fraction of rectangle width ("yby")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Disclaimer
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Legal text on the front page describing the legal status of this document as regard of liability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Duty Cycle
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of time it takes to start, operate, stop and idle a machine when it is used for intermittent duty; also, proportion of working time as compared to total operating time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Efficiency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the useful energy delivered by a dynamic system to the energy supplied to it.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Frac Job Efficiency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of Fracture Volume at end of job to Total Volume Pumped. The difference between the two volumes represents the volume which leaked off into the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: HGS Efficiency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of mass rate of HGS (high Gravity Solid) discarded through the underflow of a piece of SCE (Solids Control Equipment) to the mass rate of HGS fed into it

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: LGS Efficiency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the mass rate of LGS (low gravity solid) in the underflow of a piece of SCE (Solids Control Equipment) to the mass rate of LGS fed into it

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Displacement Efficiency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction of displaceable fluids/hydrocarbons that has been actually displaced when contacted by a displacing fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electric Susceptibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of electric field strength to electric polarization.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrical Property
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coarse classification of the electrical nature of a material; e.g. Conductive, Resistive

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrochemical Equivalent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The mass in grams of a substance produced or consumed by electrolysis (with 100% current efficiency) during the flow of a quantity of electricity equal to 1 Faraday (96,487 Coulombs); conventional unit is the "equivalent" (eq).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Exponent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A number, normally symbolized as a superscript to a term in an expression, which indicates the power to which the term is raised.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: n
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The n parameter in the Power-Law and Herschel-Bulkley rheological models. The Power_Law model is "Shear_Stress=k times (Shear_Rate at the power of n)". n is dimensionless.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: FCVF Inertial Flow Correlation Exponent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cooke's inertial fracture flow correlation exponent (a). Empirical coefficient relating Fracture inertial flow coefficient Beta to Fracture permeability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Saturation Exponent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The exponent of the Saturation term in the Archie saturation equation. Abbreviated "n".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Archie Porosity Constant (a)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The constant "a" in the Archie formation resistivity factor - porosity relationship.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Archie Porosity Exponent (m)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The exponent of the Porosity term in the Archie formation resistivity factor - porosity relationship. Abbreviated "m".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cementation Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The exponent of the Porosity term in the Archie formation resistivity factor - porosity relationship. Abbreviated "m".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flux Leakage
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The proportion of magnetic flux forced out of the pipe by the distortion of the field caused by the presence of a discontinuity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation Stiffness Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dimensionless estimate of the formation stiffness, i.e., ratio between the applied pressure and the displacement of the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fractional Surface Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The fraction of a clays specific surface area which participates in hydraulic flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Feature Dip
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dip computed on a general feature surface by measuring the difference in attribute values between two points compared to the horizontal distance between the points.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Loop Error
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Departure (error) from the exact setting of a feedback loop

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: First Derivative
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: First derivative of a scalar function

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flowrate Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Unitless quantity proportional to flowrate within a given borehole environment. Flowrate indices are comparable only when the borehole and casing sizes are the same.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: System Unique
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A system generated number that uniquely identifies an data item (Entity, Property, Representation, ...) within certain system imposed limitations on the uniqueness.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Identifier
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A number, label or code given to an object in an attempt to uniquely identify it.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Housing Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifying number often etched onto the housing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Issue
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Issue (e.g. Volume,number) of a periodical publication

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Job Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Reference number assigned to a job or service

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: PI Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Petroleum Information Alpha-Numeric code

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: PI Code Series
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Petroleum Information Alpha-Numeric code series. Example 110 for Producing Wells, 400 for Gas Injection Wells.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Part Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifier used for accounting or purchasing purpose to identify an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Object Identifier
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifier of the seismic object within the Foreign System

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Offshore Block Id
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identification of the Offshore block where the well is located

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Proposal Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Customer proposal number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Purchase Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Purchase Order Number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Range Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Jeffersonian Range Number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sale Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sale number of lease purchase

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sample Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number assigned to a formation or fluid sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sampling Bottle Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sample bottle number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Section Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Jeffersonian Section Number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Serial Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The serial number placed on a piece of equipment.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Logging Unit
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Serial number of the logging unit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sidetrack Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A sequential number identifying a particular sidetrack; 0 if no sidetracks have occurred. Used for WITS Channel SKNO.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Document
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Standard document identifier, such as an ISBN or ISSN number.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storage Label
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Label found on any stored item, such as tapes, documents, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: System Identifier
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifier of a computer system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: X Display
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: XServer Id on which application is to display output

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Host
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identification of a host computer system where, for example, an application is to run.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Internet Address
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Address by which a particular computer system may be reached over the Internet.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unique Well Identifier
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The unique Identifier given to a well or a borehole specified in a given naming system. This identifier can be granted by either an official regulatory commission such as the API 12/14 digits, the Canadian Petroleum Association (CPA) or by any organization (user, customer), described in Well.Naming_System.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: To Conn Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates which end or connection number (1 or 2 for tubulars, 3 for a hydraulic T,...) of the "To" equipment in a From_To equipment connection. The description of the "To" connection number is needed in some cases for equipment item which is last in the connection chain. When no ambiguity exists, the From_Conn_Number is the preferred property.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tool Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Acquisition system tool number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Township Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Jeffersonian Township Number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Treatment Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Internal Dowell treatment number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Version
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Software version number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Firmware Version
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Version of the firmware.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: File Format Version
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identification of the digital file format version (e.g., 3.0a). Note that this information is often encoded within the file.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Operating System Version
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Version of computer Operating System

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Activity Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: External identifier assigned to an activity (e.g. job or proposal number).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Agency Lease Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Unique lease number assigned by leasing agency

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: AFE
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifier of granted or candidate request for authorization to spend money, usually for a specified purpose and amount. Abbreviated AFE

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Code used by the API (American Petroleum Institute) to identify an industry related entity, e.g., Service Company, Country, another Standard organization, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Country Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Code used by the API (American Petroleum Institute) to identify sovereign nations, colonies, overseas territories, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Well Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A unique well identification number as defined in the API (American Petroleum Institute) Bulletin D12A.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: BHA Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An identification number assigned to a bottomhole assembly, normally for tracking purposes at the wellsite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bid Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bid number assigned by governing agency

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An identification number assigned to a drill bit, normally for tracking purposes at the wellsite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Box Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of box in which an item or sample is stored.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Company Lease Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Unique lease number assigned by owning company

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Contact Symbol
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Symbol to post on the Feature_Boundary at the intersection point with another Feature_Boundary

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Contract Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifying string for contractual agreement

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Clipping Region
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Vector of pixel values indicating which portion of an input image is represented in a clipped output; the structure of the vector is [Offset from Top, Offset from Left, Height, Width].

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Toughness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the rock resistance to crack propagation (Hydraulic Fracturing). Must not be confused with tensile strength. Obtained by compressing a slice of core with a central hole. Expressed as Pressure times square root of length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Free Fluid Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The proportion of the bulk volume of the formation which is occupied by fluids which are free to flow; commonly abbreviated FFI, measured using nuclear magnetic resonance techniques.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Free Pipe Signal
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Signal value in free (uncemented) pipe; used to calibrate and interpret cement bond measurements

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: From Property
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Code of Property of Entity from which the relationship originates.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geometrical Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A geometry-dependent weighting factor used to characterize how different media in the neighborhood of a sensor participate in the sensor measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shape Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A geometrical factor (Ca) characteristic of the reservoir areal drainage shape (e.g. circle or square) and the well location (e.g. centered).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geometry
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The geometry of an object; e.g. the geometry of an Earth formation, a Fault, a Field, a Basin, a Borehole, etc. Usually represented with a Grid, Mesh, Parametric curves, or other complex representations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shape
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A visible makeup characteristic of a particular item or kind of item. Also the spatial form of an item, or a standard or universally recognized spatial form.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sphericity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the degree of how spherical an object is, such as an Lens within a subsurface Volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tortuosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A characteristic of permeable media that is the squared ratio of the mean flow path length to the medium length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellbore Shape
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of wellbore trajectory shape; common types are: build & hold, S shaped, vertical, horizontal. In the early stages of well planning, this information, along with some key parameters, are used to generate an approximate well profile - without the requirement for detailed trajectory planning. This information is also of value for wells that have already been drilled because it is difficult to categorize wells by their detailed trajectory.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Aspect Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of width to length. Also the ratio of vertical to horizontal scales on a graph, or that of the shorter to longer axes for an ellipse or ellipsoid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Pattern Shape
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Shape of a dip pattern, e.g. Convex, Concave, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dune Shape
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Shape of a Dune type depositional environment, e.g. Dome, Parabolic, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Eccentricity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the focus-to-center distance to the length of the semi-major axis of an ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Eccentricity Squared
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The square of the ratio of the focus-to-center distance to the length of the semi-major axis of an ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ellipsoid Eccentricity Squared
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio derived from semi-major and semi-minor axes to define degree to which ellipsoid shape departs from the spherical. [1 - b**2/a**2]

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ellipsoid Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio derived from semi-major and semi-minor axes to define degree to which ellipsoid shape departs from the spherical. [(a-b)/a]

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ellipsoid Inverse Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio derived from semi-major and semi-minor axes to define degree to which ellipsoid shape departs from the spherical. [a/(a-b)]

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ellipticity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the major to minor axes of an ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fan Shape
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Shape of a Fan type depositional environment, i.e. Elongated or Crescent.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: For an ellipse, the difference between the lengths of the major and minor axes divided by length of the major axis, often expressed as its inverse (Inverse_Flattening).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inverse Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inverse of the flattening of an ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ovality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Degree of departure from roundness. Often measured as the ratio of large diameter over small diameter of an ellipse or an ellipsoid body

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Roundness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the degree of how round an object is, such as a contour on a Surface.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facture Geometry
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Characterizes the geometry of a fracture: Planar or Linear.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Grade
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A rating of some sort given to an item (e.g., equipment) by some standards organization as the API, the IADC, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Steel Grade
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Grade used to qualify the characteristics of the steel. For tubulars, grade determines the minimum yield strength and thus the burst and collapse pressures and is of importance for the proper choice of slips. The grade can be either custom, i.e. defined by the supplier, e.g. US Steel FS80, Vallourec 110 VS 22, or defined by the API, e.g. C75, J55, N80, E. Number in the API grade means the minimum yield strength in kpsi (N80: 80,000 psi). API grades for Tubing, Casing and Drill pipes can be found in the API specifications 5xx.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Grade
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Casing pipe grades given to material properties that fall within the tolerances set by API specifications; e.g., J55, K55, H40, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Grade
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Grade used by the API (American Petroleum Institute) to qualify material and/or equipment used in the industry, e.g., Tubulars.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Drill Bit Grading
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The IADC, the International Association of Drilling Contractors, grading of a drill bit based on certain criteria; e.g., Bearing Seals, Dull Characteristic, Gauge, etc. grading.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Bearing Seals
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on condition of bearing seals

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Dull
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on dullness characteristics

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Gauge
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on gauge

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Inner Rows
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on condition of inner rows

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade - Location

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Other
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on other characteristics

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Outer Rows
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on condition of outer rows

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Grade - Reason Pulled
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on reason for pulling bit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Teeth-Bearing-Gauge Drill Bit Grading
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The TBG, Teeth-Bearing-Gauge, grading assigned to a drill bit based on particular criteria. The TBG has 5 fields: Bearing, Broken Teeth, Gauge, Gauge Out of Hole, Tooth Wear.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TBG Grade - Bearing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on bearing condition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TBG Grade - Broken Teeth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on broken teeth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TBG Grade - Gauge
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on gauge.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TBG Grade - Gauge Out of Hole
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on gauge out of hole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TBG Grade - Tooth Grade
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on teeth condition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Bit Grade - Wear
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drill Bit wear grading in percentage.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Pipe Grade
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drill pipe grade

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The change in the value of a quantity per unit distance in a specified direction.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heat Flux
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The quantity of thermal energy which passes through a cross-sectional area per unit time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heat Release Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The quantity of heat released in a material per unit time. Also known as mixing power.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrogen Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the number of hydrogen atoms per unit volume of a material to that number in pure water at 75 degF. Neutron logging response depends mainly on hydrogen index.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property which indicates presence of some entity, occurrence or condition, or which quantifies some condition, often as a proportion of some local reference value. Often called _Factor or _Coefficient.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coefficient of Linear Expansion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The change in length of a material as a fraction of its total length due to a change in temperature at a constant pressure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Non Darcy Flow Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Non-Darcy (turbulence) flow coefficient ("D")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Processing Option
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of which of two or more options has been selected for data processing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Smoothing Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mode to use while smoothing horizon picks (automatic, manual).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Structural Dip Removed?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: This property specifies whether the effect of structural dipping on a particular geological zone has been removed.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Auto Exit
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicates module is to be automatically stopped when run in chain

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Auto Start
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicates module is to be automatically started when run in chain

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Base for Spacing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A flag that determines which reference along a Borehole will be used to space Boreholes on a Cross Section.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: GQI Admission Policy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifies the Geometry Query Interface (GQI) policy for maintaining the content of a geometric feature as it is edited. The most common value is POINT_SET_PRESERVING, but applications may implement others so the values are not constrained.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Node Locked Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A Y/N flag indicating whether a particular Node is locked and cannot be displaced.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property which provides a relative measure of the quality or fitness-for-purpose of data, or of some item, process, or material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Snap Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the values are snapped to a sample or sub-sample

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tracking Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The acceptable value of the crosscorrelation for continued tracking (0.0 - 1.0).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from an acoustic survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Antenna Quality Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Antenna Quality Factor (Sensitivity of Tuned Antenna)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from an array induction survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CBL Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a Cement Bond logging survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cyclic Redundancy Check
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: CRC test value for this Calibration Coefficient set.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Degradation Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indication of the extent to which the quality of an object or of data has been degraded.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Degree of Confidence
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The degree of confidence associated with any event or feature related to or detected, for example a geologic feature in/on the Earth (high, low, etc)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a density logging survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Induced quality of the dip value based on evaluation of the quality of the measured data. Ranges from 0 (bad) to 20 (good)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Quality Cutoff
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The lowest dip quality taken into account for an interpretation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Filter Cake Thickness Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data representing mud filter cake thickness.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gross Cutoff Absent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Initial" cutoff criteria are unavailable; used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a nuclear magnetic resonance logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Cutoff Absent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Net" cutoff criteria are unavailable; used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Cutoff Absent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Net_Pay" cutoff criteria are unavailable (including the fraction for which "Net" or "Net_Reservoir" criteria are unavailable); used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Cutoff Absent
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Net_Reservoir" cutoff criteria are unavailable (including the fraction for which "Net" criteria are unavailable); used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Capture Cross Section Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a neutron capture cross section survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a neutron survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Photoelectric Factor Quality Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a photoelectric factor survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pick Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Pick quality measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shock Level
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Qualitative indicator of Shock_Rate; used as a real-time indicator of vibration severity for MWD/LWD tools. Also referred to as Shock Risk

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of the state of an entity or process at some moment in time. Also the position or rank in relation to others.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tool Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicator of some condition in the operation of a tool.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellbore Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A property indicating the operational condition of a wellbore: proposed, active, abandoned, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A property indicating the operational condition of a well: proposed, active, abandoned, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Agreement Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Status of a lease agreement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Borehole Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A property indicating current status of a Borehole: Producing, Abandoned, etc. Related to the Petroleum Information (PI) codes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Contract Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Status of a contract.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Erosion State
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes if the event has been partially, totally, etc. subjected to erosion.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydraulic Fracture Stage
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Whether the fracture is considered after closure or at the end of job.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lease Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Status of a lease.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Module State
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates the execution status of a module, such as Running, Aborted, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Status
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Not perforated, perforated, plugged or squeezed

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Turbulence Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The coefficient that describes the additional pressure drop due to inertial effects for high velocity gas flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thermal Alteration Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of the thermal maturity of organic matter, based on a relationship between color of organic particles and the length and intensity of heat exposure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Collar Locator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Signal from a device which indicates the presence of a casing or tubing collar, used for depth control in logging operations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cement Bond Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of acoustic wave attenuation in a zone of interest to that measured in a well-cemented section of casing, used as an indication of the quality of a casing cement job.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Acquisition Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Software or hardware option whose selection controls some aspect of data acquisition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Confidence Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The probability that a given event will occur or that a given data set will contain a specified element.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connectedness Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A coefficient describing the connectedness of items, such as the connectedness between inclusions (e.g. lenses) in the Earth subsurface formations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Index of Determination
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient of a correlation used to determine the quality of the correlation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mis-tie Time Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the significance of a mis-tie computed on a correlation basis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Corrosion Indicator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Any of several measurements which show that material has been damaged by corrosion.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drainage Area Shape Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The shape factor for enclosed drainage areas, used to correct pseudosteady-state flow performance behavior of sinks in non-circular drainage regions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Expansion Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A factor that accounts for the change in gas density due to pressure changes, as across an orifice.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of which of two or more conditions exist, or of which option has been selected. Most flags are binary in nature with a Yes/No possibility.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating presence of gas

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geologic Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the object or data pertains to geology or was derived from geologic data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: H2S Presence Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates that hydrogen sulfide (H2S) has been detected.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: H2S Service Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Specifies whether equipment is for H2S service or not

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hierarchical Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the entities participate in a hierarchy.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Intrinsic Safety Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: When set, indicates that the equipment has been certified for use in a hazardous area. Equipment so certified has been examined by a National Certifying Authority and, where necessary, tested and found to comply with the requirement of a standard specification for the appropriate concept.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Included
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A flag indicating whether an object is included or excluded from the spatial extent of a containing object.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lag Usage Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: When set, wavelet lag is used.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mandatory
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating if a relationship is mandatory or optional for the referencing object.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Manual Control Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether the activity is/was controlled manually by the user (1) or automatically by the system or application (0)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Live Trace Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicator if trace is live or dead.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Log Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating the presence of a log, or that an item or event is to be included in a log.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Logging Cable
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Y/N: tells if there is a wireline cable inside the tubing allowing logging

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lost Time Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not an event caused a delay in operation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Low Power Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not the tool is operating in low power consumption mode. When the flag is set, the sensor warmup duration is taken into account.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multiple Intersection Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag to indicate that two geometric objects have more than one intersection; for example a wellbore may intersect a geologic feature more than once, due to the geometry of the wellbore path or that of the geologic feature.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multi Valued Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Boolean indicating if the Horizon has multiple Z values for a single X,Y location.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Memory Guard Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not a memory guard (memory saving mechanism which decreases the acquisition rate above 80% memory usage) option was selected.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Monophasic Fluid Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates if the fluid is monophasic

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Monotonic Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the data increase or decrease monotonically along their index. A monotonic function is one whose value either never increases or never decreases as the independent variable increases.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Preferred Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator which shows that a particular item is preferred over another, normally as a result of some interpretation or validation process.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Primary Output Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that data constitute a valid primary output (1) or an auxiliary output (0)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Non-Magnetic Equipment Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A flag indicating whether the equipment is made with non magnetic material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Optimum Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the activity, process or solution is optimum.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ordered Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag to indicate whether the members of a set have been ordered.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforating Condition
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Pressure condition in the well at the time of perforating; may be Underbalanced (pressure in formation higher than in borehole) or Overbalanced (pressure in borehole higher than in formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Polarity Reversal Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: When set, apply reverse polarity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Production History Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not this Flow Period is part of the Production History; i.e., set for Production History, not set for Test History

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Productive Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether object or activity is productive. An activity is considered productive if it brings the operation closer to achieving the objective.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Point Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag determining number of points used in defining certain projections, 0,1,2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Quadrant
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Quadrant in which X and Y axes are positive, 1,2,3, or 4

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Read Only Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that a record is available for read access only (cannot be updated or deleted).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Report Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating the presence of a report, or that an item or event is to be included in a report.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Right-Handed Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that a 3D axis system is right-handed: a 3D coordinate system is Right_Handed if the direction of rotation from the x axis to the y axis is counter-clockwise when viewed from a positive position on the z axis. For example, if x is East and y is North, a Right_Handed system will have the positive z pointing upward (as increasing elevation). Right_Handed is meaningless for 2D systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rigid?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that a piece of equipment is rigid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Seismic Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the object or data pertains to seismic techniques or was derived from seismic data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: If flag is set, it means that the equipment or item can only be used once before rework or replacement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Slanted Rig
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A flag indicating if the rig is slanted.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Supervised Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether the activity was supervised (1) or unsupervised (0)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Standing Oil Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates if there is standing, motionless oil

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Standing Water Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates if there is standing, motionless water

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Station Inflection
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Logical flag for each seismic station indicating whether or not it is an inflection point

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Terminal Mode Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not the setup was filled in terminal mode (e.g. via an HP hand calculator). This affects the interpretation of the Job_Duration parameter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Use Checkshot?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A processing option indicating whether or not Checkshot survey data should be used for depth-time conversion.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: User Trace Selection
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Good/bad marker

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Validation Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that validation will be or has been performed on the data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Lift Flow Regime Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag identifying flow regime flag at some depth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Welded Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Y/N : does the section has a weld or not : used as a weak point flag in coiled tubing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acquisition Enable Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not acquisition is enabled for this activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Adjustable Choke Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether this flow period was performed on an adjustable choke, i.e., when set: adjustable choke, not set: fixed choke.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bad Hole Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the hole is in poor condition (e.g. oversize or overly rugose)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Bladed
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the bit is a bladed type (PDC type bit).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bored Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag to indicate that equipment item has been bored.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cementitious Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating if the chemical is accounted for as a cement when proportioning by weight of blend. Cementitious chemicals are mostly weight extenders like bentonite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Central Line X Alignment
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Alignment of central line x-coordinate: 0 if central line is x-axis, 1 if x-axis is east west

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Closure
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the boundary of a spatial object is Open or Closed?

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Code in Catalog?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag to indicate that the Code is available in a Catalog.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Compression Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating whether or not downhole data compression is possible with this equipment.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Presence Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator which shows that some particular type of data is available.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 1 Box?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating if connection is a box (Y) or a pin (N).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 Box?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating if connection is a box (Y) or a pin (N).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Corrosive Fluid Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Is the fluid corrosive? (Y/N) Used to apply a wall erosion model to measure the pipe wall thickness.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Crossflow Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates presence of crossflow

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Derived Invflt?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the inverse flattening value of an ellipsoid has been derived from semi-major and semi-minor axis lengths.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Derived Minor?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag indicating that the semi-minor axis value of an ellipsoid has been derived from the semi-major axis length and a flattening value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Estimation Flag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the data are an estimation (Y) or not (N)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Control?
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flag marking if a layer is affected by faulting.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interporosity Flow Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the conductance of flow from matrix to fissures. Usually known as Lambda in reservoir dynamics.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Key
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: In software, data used to gain access to or to enable some otherwise restricted functionality.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location of any Earth, Region, Equipment, or other entities relative to a coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Sampling Point
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location where oil samples are taken on the separator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rectangular Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Set of coordinates specifying the position of a point in a rectangular coordinate system

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Source Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True source position

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Source Sensor Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Position of sensor placed near source, for detection of shot event.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Common Midpoint Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Common midpoint (CMP) position

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Receiver Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True receiver position

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ideal Receiver Position 0
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Idealized receiver position 0

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ideal Receiver Position 1
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Idealized receiver position 1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ideal Receiver Position 2
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Idealized receiver position 2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ideal Source Position 0
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Idealized source position 0

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ideal Source Position 1
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Idealized source position 1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ideal Source Position 2
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Idealized source position 2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reference Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Location used as a reference for other data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spherical Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Set of coordinates specifying the position of a point in a spherical coordinate system

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Receiver Orientation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Downhole receiver orientation vector

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Source Orientation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Downhole source orientation vector.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Location
