ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location of a well, region, or facility/measurement point at the surface of the Earth.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storage Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The name of the location where an item is physically stored.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Text Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Location of a section of text, such as a contract clause; typical locations are paragraph number or line number on a page.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location of the top of any Entity with a geometric extent (e.g., Zone Interval, Borehole, Borehole Segment, Rig, Arc, Edge, etc.). It is represented by some position relative to a coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Section Origin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location and orientation of the vertical section plane in which vertical section distances are measured.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location of the Bottom of any Entity with a geometric extent (e.g., Zone Interval, Borehole, Borehole Segment, Rig, Arc, Edge, etc.). It is represented by some position relative to a coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cylindrical Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Set of coordinates specifying the position of a point in a cylindrical coordinate system

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Receiver Line Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Position in a receiver line

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Receiver Line Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True position in a receiver line

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Source Line Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Position in a source line.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Source Line Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True position in a source line.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Event Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes where the event took place, e.g., Well Head, Separator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: From Mounting Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Location of the from Equipment in a From-To connection : Inside, Outside, Top, Bottom. If A is mounted on top of B in the borehole and if From_Id=A, To_Id=B, then From_Mouting_Location=Top. If Packer P is set inside casing C, with From_Id=P, To_Id=C then From_Mouting_Location=Inside

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Sampling Point
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location where gas samples are taken on the separator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geographic Location
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Geographical location, either the nearest city or geographical spot or a free text telling where the location is.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Long Term Stability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Stability over the long term

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: DPoint
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Integer representation of MWD/LWD data as transmitted from the downhole tool.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Magnetic Susceptibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the degree to which a substance may be magnetized; the ratio of the magnetization to the magnetic field strength.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Absolute value of Amplitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multi-Component Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Magnitude of multi component seismic

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum magnitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Min Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum magnitude

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sum Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sum of magnitudes

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Avg Magnitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average (mean) magnitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Multi-Use Property
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property whose meaning can only be interpreted within the context of its use; for example, the meaning of Max_Value requires a context to determine a type of measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Negative Slope
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Negative slope value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Calibrated Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum value of the range for which the equipment is calibrated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Index Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generalized maximum value of index, typically distance or time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Min Calibrated Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum value of the range for which the equipment is calibrated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Index Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generalized minimum value of index, typically distance or time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Prescale Offset
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Special Offset value used in certain calibrations It is not part of the Calibration_Coefficient list.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Offset
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Difference from a reference value, generally zero.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Positive Slope
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Positive slope value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resolution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The smallest separation between two objects such that they can still be discerned as separate objects. In sensor technology, the smallest change in input which will produce a detectable change in output. In this context, it is the same as Sensitivity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Response Parameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property which reflects the response of some measurement device or algorithm to a particular material or environment. The Unit_Quantity is determined by the type of measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sensitivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of sensor or instrument output to input.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sensitivity to Temperature Variation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sensitivity to temperature variation for a sensor

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Slope
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The slope of a function: the tangent of the angle between the x-axis and the tangent to the curve defined by the function.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Instantaneous Frequency Slope
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Least squares slope (gradient) of instantaneous frequency in an interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reflection Strength Slope
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Least squares slope (gradient) of reflection strength in an interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Threshold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The value of a property which signals some change in state or behavior of a material, process or algorithm.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Discriminator 1 Cutoff
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cutoff value for first discriminator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Discriminator 2 Cutoff
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cutoff value for second discriminator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Negative Threshold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Negative threshold value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Threshold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum threshold value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Threshold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum threshold value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Positive Threshold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Positive threshold value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value if of data type Long

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value at the top of an interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value if of data type Number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value if of data type String

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Margin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The allowable error rate, deviation from normal, or degradation of the performance of, a system or device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: First Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: First value along axis

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Axis Spacing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Spacing or displacement along axis

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value at the bottom of an interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Default Value Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Default value if number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Default Value String
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Default value if string

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Explicit Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Token, normally an integer, which is used as a reference or pointer to a value stored in some data structure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Classification Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Index into a lookup-table describing various classifications. Typical usage is a surface representation (grid) of index values, where each value represents a particular classification.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR Amplitude Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distribution of nuclear magnetic resonance amplitudes for different values of transverse relaxation time (T2); normally represented as a waveform of amplitude values indexed by T2 components.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fitting Error
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Error in NMR window sum or raw echo fitting.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The name given to any object or data item, e.g. Name of Well, Name of Field, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of method used, such as in acquiring or processing data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Model Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a model or version of some entity; for equipment, it may coincide with the trade name.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Operating System Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of computer Operating System, e.g. Unix, VMS, Windows NT.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Organization Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of organization

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Owner Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The name of the owner of an item like a piece of equipment.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Publisher
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of Organization which published of a document.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Supplier
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Supplier name of a Product.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Operator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The name of an operator of a well, an equipment, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Outer Continental Shelf Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the submerged land area called the Outer Continental Shelf

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pattern Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a pattern or style, such as a graphic pattern.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Prime Meridian Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the meridian from which longitudes are referenced. Normally the meridian through Greenwich is defined as the prime meridian.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a person

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Author
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Author of document

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Company Representative
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the client representative or company man.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Contractor Representative
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the representative of the Contractor Company

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Loaded By
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of person who loaded data

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Modified By
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of person who modified data

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Object Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of an Object

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Representation Object
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Object instance name where Representation may be found if not specified.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Object
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of Object where Unit may be found if not specified

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Constraint Object
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of Object holding descriptions of the constraints (e.g. String_Enum_Cat)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Entity Object
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the implementation object of the entity. A table name in a relational implementation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Compressibility Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the correlation model (often the author name) used to compute oil compressibility (e.g. Calhoun, Vasquez and Beggs)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Formation Volume Factor Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the correlation model (often the author name) used to compute oil formation volume factor (Vasquez_Beggs, Glaso, Standing)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Region Of Interest
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Geopolitical area of interest

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Product Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Official product name.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Zone Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: UTM Zone of projection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Compressibility Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rock Compressibility Correlation (Sandstone, Carbonate)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: SDM Domain
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the data domain, as described in the Schlumberger Data Model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Section Suffix
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A subsection single letter suffix designation a part of a Section, as used in California, USA

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Short Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Informal, usually shortened name given to an object or data item; a nickname.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Simulation Layer
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name given to a layer in a reservoir simulation model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: State Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a State

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Table Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a database Table.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Quantity Table
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of database table where Unit may be found if not otherwise indicated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Table
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of database table where Unit may be found if not otherwise indicated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Value Type Table
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of database table where value type may be found if not otherwise indicated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Element Table
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Table containing an element of a collection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Title
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A formal descriptive name, such as for a publication; also used for the role of person in an organization.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Publication
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Title of publication of a document.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Article
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Title of article or memo

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Reference Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The name of an API (American Petroleum Institute) reference, e.g., Bulletin D12A.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trade Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An arbitrarily adopted name that is given by a manufacturer or merchant to an article or service to distinguish it as produced or sold by him and that may be used and protected as a trademark.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Datum Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the permanent Vertical Datum to which the local elevation reference is related. Typical Vertical Datums are "Mean Sea Level" and "Least Astronomic Tide".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Viscosity Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Model used to compute water viscosity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name given to a well, quite possibly the legal name. The name may vary as ownership and rights are transferred.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zone Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Zone Name

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coordinate System Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geodetic System Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a geodetic coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Local Coordinate System Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a local coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the projection coordinate system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Activity Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Commonly used name for an Activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Attribute Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of an Attribute of an Object

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Representation Attr
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Object Attribute name where Representation may be found if not specified.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Attribute
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of Object Attribute where Unit may be found if not otherwise specified

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Biological Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A name used for classifying items in a biological taxonomy.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Genus
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A category of biological classification ranking between the family and the species. A class, kind, or group marked by one or more common characteristics.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fossil Genus
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name for genus of fossil within some group.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Group
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An assemblage of related organisms - often used to avoid taxonomic connotations when the kind or degree of relationship is not clearly defined.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fossil Group
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name for biological group of fossils.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Species
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A category of biological classification ranking immediately below the genus or subgenus.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fossil Species
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name for species of fossil within some genus.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Subgenus
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A category in biological taxonomy below a genus and above a species.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Column Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a Column in a database Table.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Column
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Database column name where Unit may be found if not otherwise indicated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Quantity Column
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of column in database table where Unit may be found if not otherwise indicated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Value Type Column
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of column in database table where value type may be found if not otherwise indicated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Component 1
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of first component in a mixture or composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Component 2
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of second component in a mixture or composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Component 3
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of third component in a mixture or composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Component 4
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of fourth component in a mixture or composition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Country Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a Country

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: County Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a County or Parish

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Default Currency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Default Currency used

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Display Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A name which is used for display purposes, as opposed to the formal controlled name (Code) which is used for interoperability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Fluid Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name given to the drill fluid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Structure Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the Rig or Drill Structure operating on the well

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Element Tag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tag (label) used to reference an Element of a Collection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Elevation Reference Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the local elevation reference, such as "Kelly Bushing".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ellipsoid Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the ellipsoid to which geodetic coordinates are referenced.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name given to a geologic formation; may be a local name or an accepted standard.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Field Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name given to a field; may be a company-specific or regulatory name.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: File Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The name of a computer data file.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Graphic Symbol File Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Graphic symbol file specification. [In GeoFrame, this is typically a GPD file, e.g., gpd_lib/stop_symbol.gpd]

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Graphical File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of file containing related graphical information

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Journal File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: File that maintains process history, i.e., the chain of actions performed on the object.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Library Doc File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of file containing documentation for (software) library.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Map File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of file containing standard map.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Remote File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of file on remote host

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Source File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: File containing the original description of the object, e.g., TIF file for an image.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Boundary File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of file containing boundaries

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Documentation File
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of file containing related documentation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: File System Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of computer operating system component which deals with data file storage, e.g. NFS (Unix), RMS (VMS).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Function Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a software program function.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Get Function
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of function used to read data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: J Function
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the J Function, a function used to normalize capillary pressure to account for differences in permeability, porosity, and fluid systems.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relative Permeability Function
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the function used to represent relative permeability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Put Function
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of function used to write data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Capillary Pressure Function
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the function used to represent capillary pressure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: GPD Lithology Pattern
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the GPD pattern used to draw the lithology.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geodetic Datum Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the reference system that describes the position, orientation and scale relationship of the ellipsoid and the earth, such that referenced coordinates are unique.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geodetic Datum Point
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of Origin of Geodetic Datum

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Graphic Symbol Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name assigned to a graphic symbol.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Input Data Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the data used as input.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Language
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of spoken or written language, such as English, Spanish, French, Mandarin, Russian, Chichimeq...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Default Language
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Default Language used

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lease Name
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a lease

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lease Suffix
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Suffix associated with lease (e.g., OCS-G)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Major Component
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The major component of a composition (e.g. the major component of a chemical product)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Memory Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Memory Size, generally expressed in kilobytes or Megabytes

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Hardness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The hardness of a rock sample expressed in units of the MOH reference standard.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Molecular Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the mass of a molecule of a substance to 1/12 of the mass of a Carbon12 atom; calculated as the sum of the atomic weights of the constituent atoms.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heptane-Plus Molecular Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Molecular weight of Heptane (C7H14) and heavier component concentration in crude oil. Typical value: 110-130

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Money Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of money; should be associated with a unit of currency.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Royalty
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Royalty received by lessor

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Annual Payment
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Annual amount of Payment based on some contractual agreement such as a lease. This could be rental, mortgage or other.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bid Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of lease bid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cost
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of money spent to obtain goods or services.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cost per Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of money per unit of length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cost per Mass
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of money per unit of mass

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cost per Volume
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of money per unit of volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Cost
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cost per unit amount

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cost per Time
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of money per unit of time

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lessor Bonus
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bonus payed to lessor for signing

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Digit
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Element of a representation for pressure data in which each digit in the decimal pressure (1's, 10's, 100's, etc. )is stored as a separate unitless digit. This method is obsolete, but the property is needed for mapping historical data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: No Property
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: No property code applies; this is a temporary property type used to flag Parameters and Arrays for which we cannot make a meaningful mapping to any Property.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Optical Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of light absorption by a material: for a given wavelength, Optical Density = -log(Transmittance); generally measured as an absorption spectrum for different wavelengths of light.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ordinal Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A number used to indicate the position, rank or order of items in a sequence.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Polynomial Order
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Order of term in a polynomial, such as in a multiple regression equation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rank
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Integer denoting the order of an element in a collection, such as the rank of a Layer participating in a Sequence or Stratigraphic Column.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tubular String Component Rank
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A rank denoting the order of the element in a string of tubular drilling equipment.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rotor Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of the rotor. (For a cylindrical rheometer, each number corresponds to a different size. Standard Rotor is #1)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Run Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number (or rank) associated with a particular run of a tool or activity. Use is discouraged due to ambiguity when services are combined or when complete history unavailable; time of data acquisition is more reliable.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: BHA Run Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sequence number of the bottomhole assembly (BHA) run.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Run Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sequence number of the bit run.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sensor Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sensor number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number used to identify or index an element in a sequence.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: System Copy Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number used to identify an instance of a particular type object within a set; used in conjunction with Copy_Number in GeoFrame.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Copy Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number used to identify an instance of a particular type object within a set.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shotsequence Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal ordering matching raw receiver sort

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spring Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Spring number of a cylindrical rheometer corresponding to a particular stiffness. Fann 35 spr #1stiffness is 2.2116E-3 Nm/Rad

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Stack number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Station Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth identifier

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Test Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number (or rank) associated with a particular test activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Common Depthpoint Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: CDP Line Number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Waveform Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Waveform number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zone Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An ordinal identifier that uniquely characterizes each zone

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acquisition File Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Acquisition system file number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acquisition Shot Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Acquisition system shot number

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Beginning Element Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of the first element, usually in an array or along an axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bob Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bob number. The bob is the inner cylinder of a cylindrical rheometer. Each number corresponds to a different size. Standard bob is #1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coil Tubing Section Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of the Coiled Tubing section used by the CoilLIFE module.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TKO Model Order
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of arrivals assumed per frequency in Pronys dispersion analysis (TKO)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An ordinal identifier that characterizes uniquely each dip

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top Dip Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of Dip (in the Dip Set) at the top of the Bed

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom Dip Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Number of Dip (in the Dip Set) at the bottom of the Bed

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Frame Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Multi-source/multi-receiver shot record identifier

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: From Conn Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates which end (1 or 2 for tubulars, 3 for a hydraulic tee,...) of the "From" equipment is connected to the "To" equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Level Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifier of a particular level in a sequence; used by GeoFrame as an auxiliary depth identifier.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ending Element Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of the last element, usually in an array or along an axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Index in the cumulative mineral array which are naturally indexed and not indexed by Zone_Number.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mixing Order
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Order in which the materials are added together. This order matters e.g. the acid is poured into the water and not the contrary, the water to the flour ...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Origin X
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: X component of the location of the origin of a Local Coordinate System, measured with respect to the origin of the "from" coordinate system. Units, if any, are those of the "from" system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Origin Y
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Y component of the location of the origin of a Local Coordinate System, measured with respect to the origin of the "from" coordinate system. Units, if any, are those of the "from" system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Origin Z
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Z component of the location of the origin of a Local Coordinate System, measured with respect to the origin of the "from" coordinate system. Units, if any, are those of the "from" system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Priority
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Superiority in rank, position, or privilege

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reflection Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of wave energy through a unit area perpendicular to the direction of wave travel; for a seismic wave, intensity is proportional to the square of the amplitude of displacement or velocity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relative Reflection Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of energy reflected from a surface relative to the energy reflected under specific, standard conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Refractive Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the velocity of light in a vacuum to that in the medium in question.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gamma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Factor used in T2 inversion (nuclear magnetic resonance logging) to ensure the continuity of the T2 distribution as a function of the signal to noise ratio.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Strain
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the change in dimensions or shape caused by stress, generally expressed as a unitless ratio of the change of length per unit of initial length. If not otherwise specified, strain is taken to be "normal" (in the same direction as the stress).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shear Strain
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Shear component of the change in dimensions caused by stress, generally expressed as a unitless ratio.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Probability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The likelihood that a given event will occur, expressed as the ratio of the number of occurrences of the specified event to the total number of events.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Plausibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Estimate of the likelihood that a given rock body is fractured.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Probability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The probability that gas is present in the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Occurrence Probability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The probability that an item (element, mineral, ..) occur within a particular environment under certain conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Probability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The probability that oil is present in the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductance Profile
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measurement related to conductance but not necessarily scaled or calibrated for quantitative use.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quality Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Factor which quantitatively characterizes the acoustic attenuation of a medium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Radioactivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of intensity of radiation from a material relative to a standard level of intensity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The value of one item divided by the value of another item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Recovery Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of amount of sample or material recovered to total amount recoverable.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reduced Pressure
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The pressure of a fluid divided by the critical pressure of the fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reduced Temperature
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The temperature of a fluid divided by the critical temperature of the fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resistivity Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the resistivity of a formation to the resistivity it would have if 100% saturated with formation water (Rt/Ro).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reynolds Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of inertial force to viscous force for viscous fluid flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: BS&W
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of impurities which are contained in oil produced from a well, as described in ASTM Standard Test D96-82. Traditionally called Basic Sediment and Water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shear Compressional Slowness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of shear slowness (Shear_Slowness) to compressional slowness (Compressional_Slowness).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vs/Vp
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of velocity of Shear wave (Vs) to that of Compressional wave (Vp).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mean Vs/Vp Gamma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Time average of shear-compressional velocity ratio from top to reflector.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Vs/Vp Gamma
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value of shear-compressional velocity ratio in interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Standoff Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of standoff of tubular equipment from the borehole wall, computed as the ratio of Standoff to the difference between hole radius and tubular radius; Standoff Ratio is 0 if the tubular is in contact with the hole wall, 1 if the tubular is centered in the hole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storativity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of component storativity to total system storativity. Usually known as Omega in reservoir dynamics.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storativity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of fissure storativity to total system storativity. Usually known as Omega in reservoir dynamics.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inner Outer Storativity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Radially composite system storativity ratio [inner/outer bank]

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Near/Far Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the count rate of the near detector to that of the far detector in a thermal neutron logging device

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thorium Potassium Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of concentration of Thorium to that of Potassium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thorium Uranium Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of concentration of Thorium to that of Uranium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Threshold Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Relative measure of trace value attribute; ratio of number of samples with values greater than threshold to total number of samples.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Uranium Potassium Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of concentration of Uranium to that of Potassium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transmission Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the amplitude of a transmitted wave to that of the incident wave; may be greater than 1.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trough Peak Amplitude Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of peak and trough.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trough Trough Amplitude Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of two troughs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Velocity Ellipticity Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Degree of velocity elliptical anisotropy, in the range 0 (isotropic) to 1, defined as the ratio of the difference between the major and minor axes to the major axis of the velocity ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Velocity Ellipticity Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Estimation of the velocity ellipticity flattening for a layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stack Velocity Ellipticity Flattening
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Estimation of the velocity ellipticity flattening for all layers to the current depth.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical-to-Horizontal Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of some property measured vertically to that of the same property measured horizontally; several such property types are used to characterize formation anisotropy.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical-to-Horizontal Permeability Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of vertical to horizontal permeability in a permeable medium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the volumes occupied by two components, or by one component to the total volume of the system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Pore volume per unit gross volume. Porosity is determined from measurements on cores or interpreted from logs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Apparent Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Initial estimate of porosity, normally from logs, not corrected for the (often large) effects of clays, gas, etc. Such estimates should only be used for qualitative interpretation of clean, gas-free intervals.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bin Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Contribution of porosity from a given "bin" (with certain characteristics) to the total porosity; e.g., in nuclear magnetic resonance data processing, the "bins" typically correspond to different pore size ranges.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Crossplot Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Estimate of porosity determined by plotting one type of data against another.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Porosity Dolomite
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is dolomite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Porosity Limestone
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is calcite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Porosity Sandstone
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is quartz.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Apparent formation porosity as measured with an nuclear magnetic logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity as measured with an neutron logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Porosity Dolomite
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a neutron logging measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is dolomite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Porosity Limestone
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a neutron logging measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is calcite.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Porosity Sandstone
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity derived from a neutron logging measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is quartz.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thermal Neutron Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity as measured with a thermal neutron logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Matrix Thermal Neutron
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Matrix response of a thermal neutron porosity logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Epithermal Neutron Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity as measured with an epithermal neutron device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Matrix Epithermal Neutron
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Matrix response of an epithermal neutron porosity logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sonic Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity calculated using the acoustic slowness measurement from a sonic log.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sonic Porosity Dolomite
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity calculated using the compressional wave travel time measurement from an acoustic log with a dolomite matrix travel time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sonic Porosity Limestone
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity calculated using the compressional wave travel time measurement from an acoustic log with a limestone matrix travel time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sonic Porosity Sandstone
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity calculated using the compressional wave travel time measurement from an acoustic log with a sandstone matrix travel time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Standoff Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Porosity measurement of the "standoff" region, a very shallow porosity determination used to correct formation porosity measurements from nuclear logging tools.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average value of the material Porosity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The porosity available to free fluids, excluding non-connected porosity and space occupied by bound water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gross Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The average porosity in a gross thickness interval or a group of intervals.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of the material Porosity (Porosity for a layer).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average Porosity of the levels which satisfy "pay zone" criteria; such criteria typically include cutoffs for clay content, porosity, water saturation and permeability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Core Porosity (PM)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average porosity in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from core data by point-match method.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum value for Porosity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Primary Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The porosity remaining after sediments have been deposited but without considering changes because of subsequent chemical action or water flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Log Porosity (PM)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average porosity in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average porosity in the Net Reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Secondary Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The additional porosity created by chemical changes, specially fissures, fractures, solution vugs and dolomitization.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Porosity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The total volume fraction of a rock which is occupied by fluid; includes all forms of porosity, including that occupied by bound fluids, and is independent of rock and fluid materials and of environmental effects

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Aw
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the water concentration in aqueous solutions expressed as a decimal fraction between 0 and 1 ( = 1 for pure water)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water Concentration per fluid Volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Cut
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The percent of water per total volume of liquid over a period of time for a product flow network unit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Producing Water Cut
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Producing Water Cut from the Hydraulic Unit

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellhead Producing Water Cut
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water Cut at the Wellhead while well is producing

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volumetric fraction of water in the total fluid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bulk Volume Water (fraction)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of Water with respect to the total volume; the product of Porosity and Water_Saturation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bound Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of bound Water with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Free Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of free water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Irreducible Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of irreducible water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Bound Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of bound water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Irreducible Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of water which remains after flushing with hydrocarbon, with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Bound Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of bound water in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Free Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of free water in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Irreducible Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of irreducible water in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Water Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of water in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR 3D Map
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Map of volume fractions for different transverse relaxation times (T2), different diffusion coefficients (DC), and different relaxation time ratios (T1/T2); normally represented as a series of 2D maps of volume fraction values indexed by T2 and DC components, with each 2D map representing one T1/T2 ratio.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR DC Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of diffusion coefficients (DC); normally respresented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by DC components.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR T1 Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of longitudinal relaxation times (T1); normally respresented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by T1 components.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR Relaxation Time Ratio Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of relaxation time ratios (T1/T2); normally represented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by T1/T2 components.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR DC-T2 Map
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Map of volume fractions for different diffusion coefficients (DC) and different transverse relaxation times (T2); normally represented as a 2d map of volume fraction values indexed by DC components along the y-axis and T2 components along the x-axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR DC-T1 Map
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Map of volume fractions for different diffusion coefficients (DC) and different longitudinal relaxation times (T1); normally represented as a 2d map of volume fraction values indexed by DC components along the y-axis and T1 components along the x-axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR T1-T2 Map
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Map of volume fractions for different longitudinal relaxation times (T1) and different transverse relaxation times (T2); normally represented as a 2d map of volume fraction values indexed by T1 components along the y-axis and T2 components along the x-axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coal Gas Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coal gas concentration as a volume ratio

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Fluid Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of fluid in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inverse Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the volume occupied by a fluid at standard conditions to the volume which would be occupied at specified conditions, such as reservoir conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inverse Gas Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of gas volume at surface (stock tank) conditions to the gas volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inverse Liquid Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of total liquid volume at surface (stock tank) conditions to the total liquid volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Albite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of albite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Anhydrite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of anhydrite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ash Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of ash with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calcite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of calcite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Biotite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of biotite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Carbon Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of carbon with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Carbonate Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of carbonate rock with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chlorite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of chlorite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Clay Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume fraction of clay as calculated, measured or inferred from formation properties.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Clay Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average clay volume fraction in the net pay portion of the zone interval (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir Clay Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average volume fraction of clay in the Net Reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coal Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of coal with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dolomite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of dolomite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dry Clay Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of dry clay with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Evaporite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of evaporitic rock with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Oil-Based Mud Filtrate Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of oil-based mud filtrate in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the volume occupied by a fluid at specified conditions, such as reservoir conditions, to the volume which would be occupied at standard conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of gas volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the gas volume at surface (stock tank) conditions. Normally abbreviated Bg.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of total liquid volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the total liquid volume at surface (stock tank) conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: For a sample of oil and its residual solution gas at surface, the ratio of the volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the volume at surface (stock tank) conditions. Normally abbreviated Bo; typical range 1.1 - 2.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of fluid volume (liquid + total solution gas) at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the volume of liquid and residual solution gas at surface (stock tank) conditions. Used for two-phase systems; abbreviated Bt; typical range 1.1 - 200.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Formation Volume Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of water volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the water volume at surface (stock tank) conditions. Normally abbreviated Bw; typical range .99 - 1.07.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Feldspar Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of feldspar with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Capacity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characteristic of a layer in a permeable system that describes the fraction of greater permeability-thicknesses for a layer with respect to the system permeability-thickness.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Dissolved Salt Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of dissolved salt in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Igneous Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of igneous rock with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Illite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of illite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of gas within a fluid otherwise named foam quality when the gas is used to foam the fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volumetric fraction of gas in the total fluid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Trip Gas Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bottom hole drill fluid gas content spike as output by the chromatograph after stopping circulation for a significant time interval such as when tripping into the hole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Background Gas Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drill fluid background gas content as output by the chromatograph in circulating conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Connection Gas Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drill fluid gas content spike as output by the chromatograph after stopping circulation in order to make or break connections.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Liquid Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume ratio of gas to liquid (oil + water) in a volume of fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Producing Gas Liquid Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of produced gas to produced liquid (oil + water) at the wellhead

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Solution Gas Liquid Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of dissolved gas volume to total liquid (oil + water) volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellhead Producing Gas Liquid Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of volume of gas to volume of liquids produced at the wellhead.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the volume of gas which is produced with a given quantity of oil.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Initial Gas Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas-Oil Ratio at the beginning of the production.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: GOR
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of gas to oil of the reservoir fluid at reservoir condition

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sample Gas Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of gas flowrate to oil flowrate when a sample is taken

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Solution Gas-Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the degree to which a gas is soluble in oil; ratio of the dissolved gas volume to liquid hydrocarbon volume, often designated Rs Oil

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Free Gas Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the volume of free gas to the volume of oil for a reservoir fluid at standard conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bulk Volume Gas (fraction)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of gas with respect to the total volume; the product of Porosity and Gas_Saturation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Gas Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of gas in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Gas Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of gas in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Glauconite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of glauconite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gypsum Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of gypsum with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Halite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of halite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Holdup
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: In a producing well, the volume fraction of a specific fluid phase in the upward-moving stream. The relative quantities of fluids produced are related to the holdup and upward velocity of each phase.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Holdup Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Unitless quantity proportional to holdup within a given borehole environment. Holdup indices are comparable only when the borehole and casing sizes are the same.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Holdup
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume fraction of oil in the upward-moving stream of a producing well.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Holdup
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume fraction of water in the upward-moving stream of a producing well.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Holdup
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume fraction of gas in the upward-moving stream of a producing well.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bulk Volume Hydrocarbon (fraction)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of hydrocarbon with respect to the total volume; the product of porosity and hydrocarbon saturation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bulk Volume Moved Hydrocarbon
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of moved hydrocarbons with respect to the total volume; moved hydrocarbons are those which have been displaced from the flushed zone by the invasion process.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay Moved Hydrocarbon Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Net pay moved hydrocarbon volume fraction: moved oil saturation (Sxo-Sw) in the net pay of the zone multiplied by the net pay average porosity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bulk Volume Residual Hydrocarbon
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of residual hydrocarbons with respect to the total volume; residual hydrocarbons are those still in place in the flushed zone after the invasion process.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Hydrocarbon Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of hydrocarbon in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Hydrocarbon Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of hydrocarbon in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Isolated Porosity Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of isolated porosity with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Kaolinite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of kaolinite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Gas Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume ratio of liquid (oil + water) to gas in a volume of fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellhead Producing Liquid Gas Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of volume of liquids to volume of gas produced at the wellhead; used primarily to express the amount of condensate produced in gas wells; typical unit is barrel per million cubic feet (RP66: 1E-6 bbl/ft3)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Muscovite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of muscovite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: NMR T2 Distribution
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of transverse relaxation time (T2); normally represented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by T2 components.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Shale Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum value of Shale/Clay volume fraction

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Metamorphic Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of metamorphic rock with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume of a particular mineral per unit volume of the investigated material, such as a sample.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Montmorillonite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of illite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Potash Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of potash with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Orthoclase Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of orthoclase with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Parallel Porosity Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of parallel porosity with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Brine Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of oil volume to brine volume for a fluid, such as an oil based mud

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Content
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Oil Concentration per fluid Volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volumetric fraction of oil in the total fluid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil-Gas Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the volume of oil (including condensate) to that of gas.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bulk Volume Oil (fraction)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of oil with respect to the total volume; the product of Porosity and Oil_Saturation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Oil Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of oil in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flushed Zone Oil Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of oil in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Water Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of oil volume to water volume for a fluid, such as an oil based mud

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pyrite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of pyrite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quartz+Feldspar+Mica Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of quartz + feldspar + mica with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quartz Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of quartz with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unit Recovery Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Recovery factor of reservoir fluids expressed as the ratio of standard volumes (stock tank barrels, etc.) recovered to pore volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reduced Volume
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume of a fluid divided by the critical volume of the fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sand Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume fraction of sand as calculated, measured or inferred from formation properties.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shale Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume fraction of shale as calculated, measured or inferred from formation properties.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shrinkage Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the decrease in volume of the liquid phase caused by release of solution gas and/or by the thermal contraction of the liquid; the reciprocal of formation volume factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Siderite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of siderite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Silt Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of silt with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Smectite Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of smectite with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storage Capacity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the sum of layer porosity thicknesses to total system porosity thicknesses for layered porous media.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tar Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of tar with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Undisturbed Zone Dissolved Salt Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of dissolved salt in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Organic Carbon
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume concentration of organic carbon relative to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Organic Matter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Relative content of organic matter in a material, such as a rock sample. Calculated as total organic Carbon * 1.22.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trona Volume Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume fraction of trona with respect to the total volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Von Mises To Yield Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the Von_Mises_Stress to the Yield Strength of the material : It helps determine whether the material has yielded (permanently damaged) by comparing to the yield_stress (>1, permanently deformed).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the volume of water which is produced with a given quantity of oil.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sample Water Oil Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water oil ratio when a sample is taken

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Isotope Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The isotope ratio is a value that puts into relation a measured isotope quantity versus another isotope of the same component and compares it to a standard

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Kerogen Adsorption
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the adsorption of hydrocarbon compounds on kerogen

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Eval
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of generated rock eval components per rock mass or organic content of a sample used to characterize source rocks

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Impedance Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the acoustic impedance of two adjacent beds or intervals

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CO2 Foam Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio volume of CO2 over foam volume. Indicator of the quality of a foam generated with CO2 for well treatment. Below 50% the foam is not stable, above 95% the foam changes to a mist. C02 foam are used when low pH is required.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calibration Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of measurement during logging to measurement at calibration

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Capillary Number
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of capillary to viscous forces on fluids in a porous media.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Carbon Oxygen Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of relative abundance of Carbon to that of Oxygen; important for hydrocarbon detection and saturation determination because it is independent of salinity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vp/Vs
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of velocity of Compressional wave (Vp) to that of Shear wave (Vs).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Vp/Vs
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Value of compressional-shear velocity ratio in interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mean Vp/Vs
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Time average of compressional-shear velocity ratio from top to reflector.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductivity Contrast
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity ratio between geological objects

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inter Bed Contrast
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity ratio between adjacent beds

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resistive Inclusion Contrast
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity contrast between resistive inclusions and the surrounding rock

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductive Inclusion Contrast
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Conductivity contrast between conductive inclusions and the surrounding rock

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Percentage of Downtime
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Non-operational time of an equipment with respect to total time in location

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the dry weight of a component of a system to the total dry weight of the system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gadolinium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of gadolinium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Iron Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of iron to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lead Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of lead to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Manganese Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of manganese to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Magnesium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of magnesium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Potassium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of potassium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nickel Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of nickel to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quartz+Feldspar+Mica Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of quartz + feldspar + mica to total dry weight.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Silicon Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of silicon to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sodium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of sodium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sulfur Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of sulfur to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thorium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of thorium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Uranium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of uranium to total dry weight
