ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Titanium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of titanium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Barium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of barium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Carbon Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of carbon to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cobalt Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of cobalt to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chlorine Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of chlorine to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chromium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of chromium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrogen Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of hydrogen to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Molybdenum Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of molybdenum to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nitrogen Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of nitrogen to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Phosphorus Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of phosphorus to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Albite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of albite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Anhydrite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of anhydrite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ankerite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of ankerite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Anorthite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of anorthite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chlorite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of chlorite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Clay Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of clay to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calcite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of calcite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coal Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of coal to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dolomite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of dolomite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Evaporite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of evaporite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Illite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of illite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Kaolinite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of kaolonite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Montmorillonite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of montmorillonite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Orthoclase Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of orthoclase to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pyrite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of pyrite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Quartz Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of quartz to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Siderite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of siderite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nahcolite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of Nahcolite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rhodochrosite Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of Rhodochrosite to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Aluminum Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of aluminum to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calcium Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of calcium to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Copper Dry Weight Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of dry weight of copper to total dry weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: EOU Cone Growth Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the ellipse of uncertainty cone radius increase per depth increment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective Length Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the tendency of a permeable stratum to exhibit vertical equilibrium of flowing fluids, defined as: (length / height) * SQRT(kv/kh), where length is the characteristic length of the flow path and height is the gross or net height.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Energy Half Z
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Characterization of relative distribution of energy in a layer, computed as the fractional displacement (depth or time) into an interval (layer, bed) where half of the energy is above, half below.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Epithermal Near/Far Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the count rate of the near detector to that of the far detector in an epithermal neutron logging device

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Equilibration Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The equilibrium vaporization ratio, or ratio of the mole fraction of a fluid system component in the vapor phase divided by the mole fraction of the same component in the liquid phase.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the resistivity of water-saturated rock to that of the water solution contained in the rock. Also called Formation Resistivity Factor and abbreviated "F".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fraction Above Depth Point
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Unitless fraction of an image that is displayed above the depth associated with the image.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bridging Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of fracture width to mean proppant diameter (Industry usage: 2.5.) below which bridging will occur (proppant cannot move through the fracture).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Specific Fault Transmissibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of fault transmissibility to formation transmissibility.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Retained Permeability Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction of the fracture permeability retained at in-situ conditions after taking into account the damage due to fluid residue, function of the breaker, gel concentration and temperature at closure. Has the same effect as Proppant_Permeability_Factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Normal Weakness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of normal compliance of the fracture to the total normal compliance of the fractured rock. It indicates how much of the total compliance of the fractured rock is due to the fractures. See Compliance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Shear Weakness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of shear compliance of the fracture to the total shear compliance of the fractured rock. It indicates how much of the total compliance of the fractured rock is due to the fractures. See Compliance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the frictional (tangential) force to the contact (normal) force between two objects or materials in contact.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hole Rotation Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Friction coefficient between open hole and drill string in rotation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hole Sliding Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Friction coefficient between open hole and drill string in sliding (translation only) operating mode

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hole Translation Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Vertical component of the Friction coefficient between open hole and drill string during an helical movement, e.g., reaming mode

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Rotation Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Friction coefficient due to rotation between casing and other surface (e.g. drill string).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Sliding Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Friction coefficient due to sliding between casing and other surface (e.g. drill string), when only sliding motion is present

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Translation Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Linear component of the friction coefficient between casing and drill string during an helical movement, e.g., reaming mode

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of contact and friction forces between 2 materials in dry friction conditions i.e. without lubrication (Coulomb law)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pickup Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Friction coefficient between a string and the borehole when pulling out of the hole

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Slackoff Friction Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Friction coefficient between a string and the pipe when running into the hole

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Sorption Storativity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the stored gas in the kerogen (solid hydrocarbon) to the total gas stored in the system

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geostress Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of any two far-field principal stresses in the earth; see subtypes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: SH/Sh
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of maximum horizontal to minimum horizontal stress. (Normally abbreviated SH/Sh)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sh/SV
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of minimum horizontal to vertical stress. (Normally abbreviated Sh/SV)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Initial Final Wellbore Storage Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of early-time (initial) to final wellbore storage factor ("Ca/C")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Layer Storativity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of layer storativity to total storativity ("omegaj")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Layer Transmissibility Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of layer transmissibility to total transmissibility ("kappaj")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Map Scale
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of a distance measured on a map to the actual distance. It is normally expressed as a unitless ratio (e.g. 1:1000), or as the product of a unitless ratio and the ratio of two units (e.g. 1 in = 5 mile, or .2 in/mi).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mass Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the mass of a component to the total mass.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Litho/Gross Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of Litho_Thickness to Gross_Thickness of a reservoir summation interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: N2 Foam Quality
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio volume of N2 over foam volume . Indicator of the quality of a foam generated with N2 for well treatment. Below 50% the foam is not stable, above 95% the foam changes to a mist.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Memory Usage
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of memory used to total memory.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net/Gross Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of Net_Thickness to Gross_Thickness

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Pay / Gross Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of Net_Pay_Thickness to Gross_Thickness

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Reservoir / Gross Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of Net_Reservoir_Thickness to Gross_Thickness

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mobility Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the mobility of one system or layer (permeability divided by viscosity) to that of another system or layer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Normalized Distance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized distance to the center of a point cluster in multi-dimensional attribute-space.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Peak Peak Amplitude Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of two peaks.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Peak Trough Amplitude Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of peak and trough.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Permeability Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of component permeability-thickness to total system permeability-thickness [kh(i) / kh(total)], usually known as Kappa in reservoir dynamics work.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Open Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction to which the equipment is open, e.g., 50% open

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Poisson's Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the transverse contraction of a body to its longitudinal extension when stretched. Typical values in minerals are from 0.15 to 0.3 (Carbonates:0.15, Sandstones:0.2, Shales:0.25).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Polarity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of number of positive samples to total number of samples. Equivalent to Threshold_Ratio where threshold is zero.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Porosity Length Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of the sum of layer porosity thicknesses to total system porosity thicknesses for a layered porous media.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reflection Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of the displacement amplitude of a reflected wave to that of the incident wave. Also called Reflectivity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reflection Coefficient Threshold
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum reflection coefficient when processing the multiple reflections

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Reflection Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Reflection coefficient for the case when the multiples are reflecting from the free surface

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relative Apparent Resistivity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of apparent resistivity to the true resistivity of a portion of a reservoir model (like a two-layer model).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relative Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of effective permeability divided by the absolute permeability; e.g. the relative permeability of a rock to that of any of its contained fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Relative Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of effective gas permeability to absolute permeability. Usually abbreviated as Krg

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Relative Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of effective oil permeability to absolute permeability. Usually abbreviated as Kro.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Relative Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of effective water permeability to absolute permeability. Usually abbreviated as Krw.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: T1/T2 Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: In nuclear magnetic resonance logging, the ratio of longitudinal to transverse relaxation time; used to determine polarization correction.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storativity Thickness Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of component storativity-thickness to total system storativity-thickness [phi*Ct*h(i) / phi*Ct*h(total)].

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Productivity Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Productivity ratio (actual productivity index divided by ideal (zero skin) productivity index)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Proportion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The ratio of one part of an amount to the whole, with respect to quantity or magnitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Agreement Interest
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of interest held by one of the potentially many organizations holding a lease agreement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductive Beds Proportion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of rock occupied by conductive beds within a given depth interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inclusion Amount
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of rocks occupied by inclusions within a given depth interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resistive Inclusion Proportion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of rock occupied by resistive inclusions within a given depth interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conductive Inclusion Proportion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Percentage of rock occupied by conductive inclusions within a given depth interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Percent Ownership
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Lessor percentage ownership

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Proppant Retained Permeability Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction of proppant permeability retained in the in-situ fracture condition, and due to mechanical damage excluding any damage due to fluid residue. Has the same effect than Fluid_Permeability_Factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Seismic Q-Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Quality factor for compressional waves. The ratio of 2*pi times the peak compressional wave energy to the energy dissipated in a cycle.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Q Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average (harmonic mean) value of the compressional wave quality factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Q Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of the compressional wave quality factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Qs Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Quality factor for shear waves. The ratio of 2*pi times the peak shear wave energy to the energy dissipated in a cycle.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Qs Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average (harmonic mean) value of the shear wave quality factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Qs Ratio
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interval value of the shear wave quality factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Recorder Scanning Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Scanning rate at which gauge records data

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Remarks
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Any type of remarks added to an entity instance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Response Equation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sensor response equation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flood Direction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Direction of fluid flow through the sample in the laboratory (e.g. Horizontal, Downwards, Upwards). Water-oil experiments are almost always horizontal, gas-liquid experiments may be horizontal or vertical. If they are vertical they are done in the gravity stable direction. For example gas flooding an oil filled plug would be downwards, water flooding a gas filled plug would be upwards.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Safety Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount by which some operating condition could be exceeded before reaching the theoretical operational limit, to allow for uncertainty in the actual upper limit. For upper limits, Operating Condition X (1 + Safety Factor) = Upper Limit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Safety Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume in excess of what has been calculated for the job. Used to account for loss or safety margin

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weight Safety Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Weight in excess of what has been calculated for the job. Used to account for loss or safety margin

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Frac Pressure Safety Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount by which borehole pressure should remain below fracture pressure, to allow for uncertainty in fracture pressure estimation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pore Pressure Safety Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount by which borehole pressure should normally exceed pore pressure, to allow for uncertainty in pore pressure estimation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sampling Interval
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Index interval between sequential data samples; see also Depth_Increment and Time_Increment (Sampling_Period)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Second Derivative
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gradient of gradient of a scalar function

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Skin Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The term that accounts for additional pressure drops in the immediate vicinity of a well in well performance calculations. A positive skin indicates damaged conditions, negative indicates stimulated conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Skin Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The sum of all formation, completion, deviation, geometric and fluid flow skin factors. It can be a function of the flowrate if a Non-Darcy skin effect is present.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Geometric Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: In a horizontal well, skin effect due to the limited entry in the vertical direction.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Completion Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Skin effect due the completion of the producing interval. It does not include the effect of partially completed interval (plugged perf or bad localization), but it does include Gravel Pack skin.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Deviation Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The skin effect caused by the well trajectory not being perpendicular to the bedding plane.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation Damage Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The skin effect caused by mechanical or chemical formation damage such as invasion of drilling fluids, migration of fine material, wettability change, scale deposit or bacteria. The annular volume damaged is called the Damaged Zone.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Face Damage Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The skin along the face of the fracture (natural or hydraulic).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Matrix Block Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Matrix to natural fracture skin factor in a naturally fractured system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mechanical Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sum of Completion_Skin, Formation_Damage_Skin including anything limiting the flow across the completed interval. Does not include Partial_Completion_Skin.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Non-Darcy Skin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The skin effect resulting from turbulent flow conditions within the reservoir or the completion. This is the only skin which is flowrate dependent.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Partial Completion Skin Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The skin effect caused by flow convergence due to not completing the entire flowing thickness. Does not include the skin due to the completion itself.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Solubility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the amount of one substance (the solute) which will dissolve in a given amount of another (the solvent).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Solubility In Water
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the degree to which a gas is soluble in water, often designated Rs Water

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acid Solubility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of rock, normally expressed as a percentage by weight soluble in a given acid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Solubility In HCL
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of rock, normally expressed as a percentage by weight soluble in HCl

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Solubility in Regular Mud Acid
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of rock, normally expressed as a percentage by weight soluble in Mud Acid (standard mixture of 12 % HCl and 3% HF)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Source
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The source of an entity instance, usually a user name or an application (or activity) instance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Detection Source
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The source of information used to detect dips (e.g., Seismic data, Structural analysis, Dipmeter log data, etc.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Detection Source Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The source of the data used to detect faults (e.g., Seismic data, Structural analysis, Dipmeter log data, etc.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sample Origin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: General location from which a fluid sample was taken (test line, mud pit)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interpretation Origin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Specify where interpretation was performed on data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Magnetic Declination Source
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of a declination survey, a vendor of declination data, a reference book, or a person supplying the value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: X Spacing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Spacing in X dimension; may be expressed as an absolute spacing with units or as a proportion of some reference X Spacing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Y Spacing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Spacing in Y dimension; may be expressed as an absolute spacing with units or as a proportion of some reference X Spacing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Z Spacing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Spacing in Z dimension; may be expressed as an absolute spacing with units or as a proportion of some reference X Spacing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sparse 2D Data
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A data set of sparse location data in 2-space, where none or up to n Properties may be represented at each location. Example: X_Coordinate,Y_Coordinate,Porosity,Density.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sparse 3D Data
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A data set of sparse location data in 3-space, where none or up to n Properties may be represented at each location. Example: X_Coordinate,Y_Coordinate,Z_Coordinate,Velocity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Specific Heat
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amount of heat in calories required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of substance by 1 degree Celsius.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spectral Fluorescence Intensity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Intensity of light emitted by a material represented as a function of emitted light wavelength and wavelength of the excitation beam, typically an ultraviolet light source.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Statistical Property
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A property of statistical nature, e.g. Standard Deviation, Average or Mean, Median, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Statistical Skewness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A statistical measure of asymmetry in a distribution.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Skewness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Skewness of seismic amplitude (normalized).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Uncertainty
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Precision with which a measurement is known; often implies a 50-50 chance that any one of a series of measurements will fall within a given range; the unit quantity is determined by that of data value. Uncertainty is not necessarily related to Accuracy.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tolerance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Allowable uncertainty or deviation from a standard; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Negative Tolerance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of negative tolerance on a measurement value; the unit quantity is determined by that of data value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Positive Tolerance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of positive tolerance on a measurement value; the unit quantity is determined by that of data value.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Variance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the width of the probability distribution for a single random variable; the square of standard deviation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Accuracy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extent to which a measurement approaches the true value of a quantity; usually expressed as a fraction of the true value or, for instrumentation, full scale.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Accuracy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The maximum difference, over the calibrated range, between pressure applied to the gauge, with a reference standard, and the pressure measured by the gauge.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Temperature Accuracy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The maximum difference, over the calibrated range, between temperature applied to the gauge, with a reference standard, and the temperature measured by the gauge.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transit Time Accuracy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The accuracy attached to the transit time measurement or computation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chi-Square
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Statistical test of data distribution, used to measure goodness of fit of the data to some distribution model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Covariance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the common variance between two quantities; a non-normalized crosscorrelation function.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Error
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The deviation of a measurement from the true value; usually expressed as an absolute quantity rather than as a fraction; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Error Band
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tolerance range within which the measurement should remain; the sum of the positive and negative tolerances. May be scaled in measurement units or expressed as a proportion of the instrument rating.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Kurtosis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the sharpness of a population distribution. If X10, X25, X75 and X90 are the values for which 10, 25, 75, and 90 percent of the population is smaller, respectively, then kurtosis = (X75 - X25) / 2(X90 - X10).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Kurtosis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Kurtosis of seismic amplitude (normalized).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Model Fit Error
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic property for a measure of how well the actual data fit a model of the expected values and/or distribution of data. Standard measures include Standard Deviation, Variance, Chi-Square.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Precision
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The repeatability of an instrument measured by the mean deviation of a set of measurements from the average value; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Normalized Quantity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized property derived by a statistical algorithm normalizing between 0. and 1. the original values of some numerical data; the original data Property code and normalization range may be documented in Remarks.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Standard Deviation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Statistical standard deviation from the mean value for some data; normally abbreviated a lowercase sigma; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Amplitude Standard Deviation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Standard deviation of seismic amplitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Storativity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Product of Porosity and Total Compressibility for a reservoir hydraulic unit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Storativity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fracture Storativity (Porosity * Total Compressibility product) of a finite conductivity vertical fracture ("(phi*Ct)f")

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Turbidity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the degree to which light traversing a medium is scattered; for water, the scattering is due to particulate material and/or soluble colored compounds. Turbidity is most commonly measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of any item. Applies to all items in all domains.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Survey East West
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether survey location is East or West of reference line, such as principal meridian.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Survey North South
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether survey location is North or South of reference line, such as survey baseline.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Survey Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of survey, such as one performed on a Well, e.g., Check Shot or Deviation Survey, or on a Region, Land or Marine, , e.g., Seismic survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tank Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tank type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tectonic Cycle Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of tectonic cycle, i.e. distensive or compressive.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tectonic Feature Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of tectonic environment associated with an Earth subsurface, e.g. Fault, Fold, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tensile Failure Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mode, or geometry, of tensile failure in a wellbore; depends on the direction of the principal wellbore stress that causes the tensile failure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Thread Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of thread for casing pipe (such as short, long, buttress, extreme line)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conn 1 Thread Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Complete and non ambiguous identification of the first threaded connection, e.g., "Hydril Joint Type EIU", "Pittsburgh Special ACME-Thread Casing-Internal-upset"

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Conn 2 Thread Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Complete and non ambiguous identification of the second threaded connection, e.g., "Hydril Joint Type EIU", "Pittsburgh Special ACME-Thread Casing-Internal-upset"

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unconformity Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of an unconformity in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Joint, Disconformity, Diastem, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Upper Surface Relationship
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of relationship between a surface and the ones above (e.g. the surfaces below a Horizon are onlapping.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tool Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Tool usually used in some activity, e.g. CNTA, USIT, AIT, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wireline Tool Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Tool usually used in some wireline activity, e.g. CNTA, USIT, AIT, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Survey Tool Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of survey tool such as single shot, multi shot, gyro.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: LWD Tool Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a tool used for Logging While Drilling.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: MWD Tool Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a tool used for Measurement While Drilling.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Treating Flow Path
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates how the fluid is pumped into the well e.g. by the casing, the tubing, the annulus Casing-tubing ...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of an Earth subsurface region or volume, e.g. Formation, Reservoir, Tank, Bed, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Rate Meter Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of liquid meter used to measure the water rate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wavelet Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of wavelet used to deconvolve seismic data or to convolve with a basic reflection model to produce synthetic seismic data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Test Model
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of well test: e.g. Conventional, Horizontal, Interference, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Test Model Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Well Test Model selected

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well test Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of test conducted on a Well.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Treatment Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Matrix acidizing, Cementing, Acid fracturing, Hydraulic fracturing, Gravel Packing ...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellbore Purpose
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A property indicating the purpose of a wellbore (borehole).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellbore Storage Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes Wellbore storage behavior as either constant, variable (exp), or variable (erf).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellhead Connection Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of wellhead connection (flange, tree- saver ..); data must identity the mechanical item unambiguously to allow a hydraulic connection e.g. Studded Flange API BX150-15000 psi.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wetting Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification of the wetting characteristic of the rock, such as Oil Wet or Water Wet.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zone Set Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a set of zone intervals traversing one or more Boreholes and/or one or more Earth subsurface Volumes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Production mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes what controls the production flow of the well (e.g. constant wellhead pressure, constant flowrate)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Projection Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Characterizes the way a well borehole is projected onto a cross section.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Accident Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental accident such as Fluid Spill, Kick While Drilling, Kick While Tripping, ...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acquisition Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type or mode of data acquisition

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Activity Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of an Activity performed on a Well, a Region, or an Earth subsurface component, e.g. Drilling, Seismic, Logging, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Allowed Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Allowed position of an equipment item with respect to the assembly in which it operates.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Arc Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of Arc objects which bound surface regions of the Earth, e.g. State Boundary, River, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Availability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of the degree to which data, a product or a service is available for use; used to classify E&P data in order to support filtering of non-essential data from output.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Pin Connection Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: API pin connection type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Azimuth Reference Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of geographical object used as reference for azimuth measurements: by default, azimuths are referred to True North.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coordinate System Transformation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of Transformation used between 2 coordinate systems, e.g. Molodensky, Affine 2D, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cable Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of cable.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calibrator Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of device used to calibrate the sensor or tool.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Baselap Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Baselap in the Earth subsurface, whether it is an Onlap or a Downlap

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Battery Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Recorder battery type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bearing Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of bearing, such as sealed or mud lubricated

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bed Characterization
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The Characteristic given to a Bed or layer (e.g. has sealing characteristic or is probable source rock.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bedding Set Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of bed grouping

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bedding Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The general physical and structural character or pattern of beds and their contacts within a rock mass; e.g., cross-bedding and graded bedding; homogenous, wave ripples, planar cross beds.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bioturbation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of Bioturbation: the mixing of sediments by burrowing organisms.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Profile
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Profile of the bit (PDC type bit)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Boat Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Supply boat, tanker, dynamic positioning vehicle etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottomhole End Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates what limits the total depth (plug back, borehole bottom, bridge plug, sump packer ...)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Boundary Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Boundary in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Facies Boundary, Sequence Boundary, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Addition Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes how the bulk material was added to the mixture.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Burner Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of burner

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Business Associate Job Title
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The assignment of an administrative job title to a business associate in the context of a business association

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Business Line
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Group of activities or services gathered by some commonalities

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Business Region Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Business defined region of the Earth surface, e.g. Field, Lease, Concession, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of casing or tubing used, such as riser, conductor, intermediate, liner, surface, tubing, production, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cement Additive Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of additive(s) used to change the properties of the cement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cement Retarder Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of material used to retard the setting of the cement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cement Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of cement

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cementing Unit Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cementing unit type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Centralizer Test Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Centralizer Test used to test a centralizer, usually during any well operation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Centralizer Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Centralizer used to center a casing, a tubular, or a logging tool in the center or near the center of the borehole, aligned with the borehole axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chemical Function
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Primary purpose of a chemical e.g. Corrosion_Inhibitor, Gelling_Agent, Retarder, Emulsifier, ...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chemical Product Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Chemical Product used in various types of activities, usually those provided by Dowell-Schlumberger

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Chemistry Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of chemical system.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Choke Manifold Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of choke manifold

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Classification
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Systematic arrangement in groups or categories according to established criteria.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Classification Group
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Associates class definitions into one family: Generic, Unsupervised, Pore_Fluid, Lithologic, Seismostratigraphic, Texture, User_Defined_Mix, User_Defined_No_Mix.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Classification Method Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of method used for classification: e.g. Statistical, Artificial Neural Net, or Clustering.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Classification Scope
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Per Method expects a maximum of one parameter instance per classification activity. Per Class expects a maximum of as many parameter instances as classes were involved in the classification activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Company Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Company, e.g. E&P, Service, Contractor, Vendor, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Completion Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of well completion.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cushion Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of fluid in the test string prior to initial open of the well.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cutter Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of cutters, as used in drilling reamers (such as Type T, F, or B)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: DST Gauge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of DST Gauge Adapter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Direction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Direction of data flow, e.g. Input, Output or both.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Focus Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates how the entity set to be used as the starting point of a query is formed.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Reduction Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method used for data reduction, e.g. Linear decimation, Logarithmic, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Confidentiality Level
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the confidentiality of the information related to the well, e.g., Tight (operator only), Sensitive (some restriction), Public

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 1 Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of the top or the first standard tool connection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of the bottom or second standard tool connection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Tubing Connector Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of casing or tubing connector according to that particular thread manufacturer; e.g., 8 RD ST&C, 8 RD LT&C, Buttress, Hydril F J-P, Atbrad FL-3S, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Constraint Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of constraint. Examples include UNCONSTRAINED, STRING_ENUM, INTEGER_ENUM, INTEGER_RANGE, FLOAT_RANGE, DATE_RANGE, ENTITY_CLASS, CATALOG_ATTR, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Construct
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Construct specifies how instances of the given Value Domain are assembled into a single Value. Together Value Domain and Construct are used to derive Value_Type. Construct can be null (for a single value), L (for List), V (for Vector) , LL (List of Lists) , VL, PL, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Contact Throw Sense
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Specify whether contact corresponds to upthrown or downthrown portion of fault.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Contact Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of contact or interface between Earth subsurface regions

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Core Sample Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifies the type of core sample, such as Main, Plug, Slab, Sidewall, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coring Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of method used to acquire a core sample; e.g. Rotary Conventional, Rotary Sponge, Sidewall Mechanical, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cost Charge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the cost allocation is valid for the start (Start), end (End) of activity or at a given date (User)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cultural Feature Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of cultural feature that is to be found on a map

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Default Display Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Default type of display used for a data object, such as an Array.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Depositional Environment Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of deposition that has created a particular Earth environment, e.g. Reef, Beachrock, Pointbar, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Derivative Model
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Derivative Model used in evaluating this Transient, e.g., Backward, Central, or Forward.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Derivative Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of derivative used in evaluating this transient.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Differential Pressure Gauge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sensor used to acquire gas differential pressure across orifice plate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Pattern Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of pattern created by the earth dipping planes, e.g. Green, Red, Blue, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of dipping associated with subsurface planes; e.g., CrossBedding, Fault, Fracture, BedBoundary, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip_Classification
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification information for the dips as dip color (RGB), shape, or type.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Validity Zone Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: This property specifies whether the zone where the dips were computed corresponded to a Blank zone with no dips, a Mirror Image zone, or a borehole Washout zone.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Discontinuity Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of discontinuity: a detectable interruption in the material which may or may not have undesirable connotations (e.g. crack, lap, seam, pit, lamination, etc.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top Discontinuity Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Discontinuity forming the top boundary

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom Discontinuity Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Discontinuity forming the bottom boundary.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Bit Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of the drill bit, such as Roller Cone or PDC.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Collar Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of drill collar, such as spiral, normal, slip & elevator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Downhole Tool Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of downhole drilling tool.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Hole Opener Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of tool i.e. standard, bull nose hole opener, underreamer, LHO (Large Hole Opener with rollers),roller reamer, 3-Point Roller Reamer, 6-Point Roller Reamer

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Jar Shock Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type such as hydraulic jar, mechanical jar, shock sub

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Bit Motor Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of the Motor or Turbine used during a drilling activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Pipe Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic drill pipe type such as Normal Grade, Heavy Weight, Hevi-Wate, or Thick Wall

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Slot Cluster Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of drill slot cluster such as template and pad

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Stabilizer Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic stabilizer type such as Welded Blade, Integral Blade, Replaceable Sleeve, Clamp-on, Rubber Sleeve, Rockback, RWP (replaceable wear pad)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Structure Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of drilling structure such as land rig, barge rig, submersible rig, jack-up rig, semisubmersible rig, drillships, structure rig

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drill Sub Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of sub - bent, bent orienting, cross-over, bitsaver, kelly-saver, extension, UBHO (Universal Bottom Hole Orienting), float, saver, lift, pressure release, etc

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: East West Reference Line
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the East or West boundary line of the survey area has been used as a reference for East_West_Distance values.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Equipment Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type or class of an equipment used for some activity, e.g. Sensor, Drill Bit, Turbine, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Event Class
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Event classification by type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Event Subclass
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Event classification by Subclass

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Existence Kind
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification of the lifecycle state of an entity: actual, planned, predicted, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facies Boundary Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Facies Boundary in the Earth subsurface

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facies Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Facies in the Earth subsurface

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Characterization
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characterization of a Fault in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Sealing, Non Sealing, Constant Pressure, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Distortion Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of distortion associated with a fault plane, e.g. Rollover, Drag, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fold Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of fold (e.g., Rollover)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Foreign System
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of seismic system: Charisma, IESX

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Format
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: General plan of organization or arrangement, such as for a computer data file or for the presentation of data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Date Format
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Specification of how date information will be formatted.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Digital Encoding
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identification of how data are encoded digitally; e.g. ASCII, Binary, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: File Format
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of file structure in which the depiction rendering is encoded; e.g. PostScript, ANSI text, GIFF, JPG, Maker Interchange Format (MIF), SGML, HTML.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Display Name Format
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Specification of how the name of a data item will be displayed to the user.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Formation System
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Formation system assigned by the client

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fossil Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of fossil (animal or plant remnant from past geological ages, preserved in the earth's crust)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Fault in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Normal, Hinge, Reverse, Dextral, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Faulting Time wrt Sedimentation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Time of faulting with respect to the sedimentation process, e.g. Post Deposition, Post Compaction, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Faulting Time wrt Tilt
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Time of faulting with respect to tectonic events which tilted the bed, e.g. Anterior, Posterior

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Feature Intersection Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Defines how a Wellbore intersects with a Geologic Feature

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: File Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic property for computer file types.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Firing Head Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of TCP Equipment: firing head, debris sub, shock absorber, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Direction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates the flowing mode of a well completion; typically Injector or Producer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Direction Setup
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates the wellbore flow direction for which an equipment item has been configured.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Head Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of flow head

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Regime
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The flow condition of a multiphase process stream; e.g. slug, mist, or stratified flow.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flow Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of flow of a fluid, e.g. Laminar, Pivot, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Contact Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of fluid contact between Earth subsurface regions or volumes, e.g. Oil Water Contact, Gas Water Contact, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Marker Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a fluid marker depending on the fluid type occupying either side of the surface intersecting the borehole (e.g. Gas above Oil, Oil above Water, etc.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The phase of a fluid (gas or liquid)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Return Outlet
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Location of drilling fluid outlet of the circulating system. It is normally on the rig floor at the level of mud pit. In some offshore cases (conductor) it can be on the sea bed.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of fluid. Usually associated with a formation, a reservoir, borehole, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Injected Fluid
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of fluid injected.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lower Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of fluid found in the layer below a reference surface (e.g. Water in layer below a Fluid Contact in a Reservoir.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Upper Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of fluid found in the layer above a reference surface (e.g. Water in layer above a Fluid Contact in a Reservoir,)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Transfer Fluid
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Liquid displaced away during sampling

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Well Treatment Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Fluid used in Well Treatment operation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Base Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of the base fluid usually used in chemical mixing, such Oil or Water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Coring Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of fluid that was in the borehole at the time the coring operation was in progress; e.g. water, brine, oil, mud, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Displaced Fluid
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of fluid displaced by the injection of another fluid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drilling Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of the fluid used during a drilling activity; e.g., chemical gel mud, crude oil, caustic (high ph), gypsum mud, native mud, air, salt water, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flowing Fluid Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of fluid flowing into or out of a well completion: Condensate, Oil, Gas, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dosing Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The way an additive is measured e.g. By Weight Of Cement, BOW, gl/sk ....

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IADC Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: International Association of Drilling Contractor Code, used for drill bits.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: IPR Fluid Flow Model Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Inflow Performance Behavior for the Hydraulic Unit (Darcy, Forcheimer, Vogel, Cheng)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Condition
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Characterizes the condition of the fracture with respect to its void space; e.g. Open, Closed, Vuggy, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Element Distribution Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of spatial variation (linear or elliptical) of fracture height, width and conductivity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Origin
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Characterizes the origin of a fracture i.e. natural (inherent) or induced.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facture Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of formation fracture.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Description Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of data describing the gas: complete hydrocarbon composition, impurities (H2S, CO2,N2) or gas gravity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Gravimeter Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of instrument used to measure gas gravity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Line Pressure Gauge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gauge used to measure gas meter pressure

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Line Temperature Gauge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gauge used to measure gas meter temperature

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Meter Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of meter used to measure gas flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Pressure Axis Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: One of the pressure transformations used in Gas Well Interpretation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geologic Age Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of geologic age unit; e.g., Era, Period, Epoch, Age.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geological Influence Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of geological influence that dominates some feature such as a sedimentary channel, e.g. Wave dominated, Delta dominated, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geophone Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of geophone, used to detect particle motion associated with the passage of a seismic wave.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geopolitical Region Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a geopolitical region, e.g. Nation, State, County, Province, Community, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Granulometric Sequence Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: This property specifies whether the granules making up a Earth subsurface sequence are coarsening up or fining up.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: H2S Service Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of H2S corrosion service capability, e.g., Proof or Resistant

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heater Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Heater type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hemisphere Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Code of the earth hemisphere (Northern or Southern) in which this projection is located.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Borehole Condition Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a borehole condition.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Horizon Tracking Event
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of waveform event identified by the Horizon (crossing +/-, crossing -/+, peak, trough)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Horizon Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Horizon in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Seismic or Geological

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydraulic Model Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Flow Behavior for the Hydraulic Unit, including the Inner Boundary Type + Reservoir Behavior Type + Outer Boundary Type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrophone Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of geophone, used to detect pressure changes associated with the passage of a seismic wave.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interruption Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of interruption in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Missing Section, Repeat Section, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inclusion Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of inclusions in a rock e.g. pebble, nodules, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Index Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of index for indexed data, such as Measured Depth (MD), True Vertical Depth (TVD), etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inertial Flow Coefficient Correlation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inertial Flow Coefficient Correlation (e.g. Saucier, Firoozabadi, etc. )

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Injection Point
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates where a fluid is injected in the main flow e.g. Low Pressure Discharge...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inner Boundary Condition Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of the inner boundary condition for a well test model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Line Style
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Line drawing style, such as pattern of dots and dashes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Line Thickness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Line drawing width or thickness

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Earth Line Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of an Earth curvilinear object, e.g. the line along the intersection of 2 subsurface horizons.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Phase
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The physical state or phase of a material, such as Liquid or Solid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Material Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type or class of materials both naturally occurring or used in some activity, e.g. Hydrocarbon, Mineral, Rock, Steel, Proppant, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Blade Material
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Material used in the blade, such as steel, aluminum or plastic. This material represents material of sleeve structure in sleeve type stabilizers and is the same as the body material in integral stabilizers.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lithology/Rock Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The classification of lithology in a stratified environment, e.g. Carbonate, Shale, Sand, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lower Surface Relationship
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of relationship between a surface and the ones below (e.g. the surfaces below a Horizon are eroded).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Pump Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of pump used to pump drilling fluid or mud, usually into the borehole during drilling operations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of mud used

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Naming System
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Name of the system which controls the valid or legal names of entities. For example, there are numerous system for naming wells: API 12 digit, CPA, Tobin

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Topological Neighborhood
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A topological property indicating whether a spatial object lies to the "left" or to the "right" of a neighboring object whose orientation sense has been specified.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Gun Phasing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Phasing of the perforating gun for the given perforated interval. Standard phasings include Inline (0 deg), Spiral (45, 60, 90, 120, 180 deg), Tangential(90-270 deg).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Gun Position
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The position of the perforating gun relative to the tubing/casing in the borehole. Options include: Positioned (usu. Through-Tubing guns), Not Positioned (usu. Casing guns), Centralized.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Memory Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Memory Type, e.g., EEPROM, RAM ...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Merge Strategy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Strategy for merging data, such as into a waveform gather.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Method Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of method used in an analysis activity in the lab or other type of activities at the wellsite. For example: chemical treatment methods.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Preparation Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method by which an item or sample has been prepared for subsequent operations or analysis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Core Preparation Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method by which a core sample has been prepared for analysis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Preservation Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method by which an item or sample, such as a core sample, has been preserved.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Core Preservation Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method by which a core sample has been preserved.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ramping Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method to ramp (tapering) the time window, e.g., Hamming, Hanning...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stacking Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Stacking method (e.g. median, average, auto, manual)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TVD Computation Method Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method of defining the wellbore trajectory based upon directional survey data; includes curve fitting to the survey points and extrapolating beyond them.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Anti-Collision Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method used for calculating the proximity: 0 - Normal; 1 - Horizontal; 2 - Least Distance

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Blocking Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Blocking method

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Classification Method Code
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification method used in this activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Computation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Computation method used in the generation of data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: EOU Computation Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Method used for calculating the ellipse of uncertainty: 0 - Wolfe & de Wardt; 1 - Conic

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interpolation Method
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Interpolation method used in the generation of data.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Classification
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The classification of a mineral.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Group
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The group to which a mineral belongs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mineral Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a mineral.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mixture Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Qualifier to determine if a component is a pure chemical or a mixture of other chemicals.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Morpho Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The classification of rocks from their internal morphology i.e., lamination thickness, inclusion size, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Pump Monitoring Purpose
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The purpose of the mud pump monitoring. It can be either for well control or monitoring the pump parameters at working conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Drop Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Pressure drop correlation (e.g., Dun-Ros, Cullender, )

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Drop Correlation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Pressure drop correlation (e.g., Dun-Ros, Cullender, etc. )

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Operation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of pressure-operated mechanism. Certain tools are be operated by either tubing or annulus pressure. These tools frequently contain a rupture disk or break plug and are single-shot.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Point Setup
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Identifies the location of the fluid whose pressure is being recorded.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Node Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of (topological) Node, as used in the Region submodel.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: North South Reference Line
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Indicates whether the North or South boundary line of the survey area has been used as a reference for North_South_Distance values.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Operating Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Operating mode of an equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Role
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Role of organization (e.g. Business Associate)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Outer Boundary Condition Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of the outer boundary condition for a well test model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Packaging Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Packaging or container used for products, such as Drum, Sack, Bulk, Pieces, Pallets

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Packer Motion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Internal tubular (e.g. tubing) motion allowed by the packer during an increase in pressure. Choices: Free (Packer does not restrain motion), Limited (tubular is free to shorten but not lengthen) and No Motion.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Packer Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of packer; supplier type like Dowell Model 21. No simple type description available but the supplier identification.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Partial Completion Model Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Model used to compute the Partial Completion apparent skin effect

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Charge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of explosive charge used in a perforating gun.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Gun Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of perforating gun used to shoot the given interval of the tubing (or casing) in the borehole. Examples are: 3-3/8" 6 SPF, 3-3/8" HJ HI-TEMP, 4" HJ II, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The method used to open the production in the borehole. Examples are: Bullet, Jet, Combination, Open Hole, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Personnel Role
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Role of the personnel counted in Personnel_Count; these may be implemented as lists.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Occurrence Order
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The order of occurrence of a particular item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Gravimeter Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of instrument used to measure oil specific gravity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Line Temperature Gauge Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of gauge used to measure oil line temperature of separator

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Rate Meter Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of liquid meter used to measure oil rate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Viscosity Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Model used to compute oil viscosity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Plane Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a plane in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Bed Plane, Fault Plane, Fracture Plane, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Platform Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a platform.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Play Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A type or code assigned to a lease. Play codes can be internal to company and are usually based upon geographic boundaries or geologic trends.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Earth Point Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of an Earth zero-dimensional object such as a marker.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Porosity Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The porosity type usually of a core sample or in either a carbonate or clastic rock formation (e.g. Intercrystal, Breccia, Vuggy, etc.),

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Related Sample Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of related samples taken in the recombination set

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relationship Constraint Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of constraint for a relationship, such as Restrict, Cascade, or Nullify.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relationship Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of relationship between two objects: Containment, Reference, Supertype, Catalog,etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relative Permeability Basis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Absolute or effective permeability basis for the relative permeability.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Production History Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of production/Injection data set : Previous_Flow_History (Production), Injection, Previous_Flow_History (Production), Simulated_Behavior (Test), Actual_Field (Flow)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Coordinate System Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Projection coordinate system, e.g. Lambert, UTM, State Plane, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Projection Class
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Base projection type (e.g. TM for UTM_1)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pumping Schedule type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of pumping schedule i.e. as measured, design, alternate...

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Range Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Specification whether the value range is inclusive[], exclusive (), or mixed: [) or (].

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Recorder Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Recorder type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Representation Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of computer representation used to manipulate a property value, e.g. Grid, Array, Primitive, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reservoir Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Description of the reservoir type for a well test model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rheology Model
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mathematical model describing how the shear stress relates to the shear rate i.e. how a fluid flows and is deformed in response to applied stresses. Most popular model are Newtonian, Bingham Plastic and Power-Law

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rights Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of lease rights

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Class
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification of rocks into Chemical, Volcaniclastic, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Genesis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification of rocks by genetic origin, e.g. Sedimentary, Igneous, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Subclass
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Classification of rocks into Carbonate, Evaporite, etc. Commonly called Lithology.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rotation Sense
