ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the sense of the axis system rotation specified by {ROTATION_1,ROTATION_2,ROTATION_3}. Most commonly used are "X_Y_Z" and "Z_NEWX_NEWZ".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Running Direction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Running direction of an equipment: Pulling Out Of Hole-POOH (Up=-1) or Running In Hole-RIH (Down=1)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Safety Drill Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental safety drill such as Fire Drill, Abandon Ship Drill, Spill Control Drill.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sales group
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Within a business line, Sales services are gathered by group with technical commonalities.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sample Nature
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nature of the sample e.g. oil or gas

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sampling Bottle Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of sampling bottle

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Scan Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the way in which a subject is scanned to take data samples or to generate an image.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Screen Motion
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An indicator of the current state of the movement induced by the vibrator(s) of a shale shaker screen

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shale Shaker Screen Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of screen tension (deck tensioned or factory pretensioned)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Section Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Jeffersonian Section Type such as a Lot

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sedimentary Channel Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of the sedimentary environment that created the channel, e.g. Submarine, Stream, Tidal, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sedimentary Feature Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of the sedimentation feature associated with a subsurface or surface Earth region.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sedimentary Structure Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of sedimentary structure associated with an interval.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sedimentary Unit Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of sedimentary unit e.g. channel, bar, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Seismic Object Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of seismic data object: data or survey geometry, 2 or 3D

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sensor Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of sensor used to acquire data

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Sensor Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of surface sensor such as depth sensor, hydraulics depth sensor, kelly revolution sensor, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Temperature Sensor Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of temperature sensor

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pressure Sensor Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Pressure sensor type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Separator Line
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of separator line: e.g. oil outlet, gas outlet, water outlet or inlet

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Separator Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Separator type

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Sequence Boundary in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Toplap, Concordance, Baselap, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Lower Limit Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of surface situated at the base of a sequence.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Order Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The order of a sequence in the depositional process.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Surface Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of surface bounding a particular sequence.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Trend Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of vertical evolution recognized in a particular sequence e.g. fining up.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of sequence, e.g. granulometry, thickness, facies, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sequence Upper Limit Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of limit bounding the top of a sequence.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Service Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of service

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Setting Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mode for setting a plug or packer: by compression or inflation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Setting Tool
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Generic type of plug or packer setting tool: Drill-Pipe or Wireline

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shear Failure Mode
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mode, or geometry, of shear failure in a wellbore; depends on the magnitude and direction of the two orthogonal principal wellbore stresses that cause the shear failure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Show Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of hydrocarbon show from a Well or from a Sample (Core, Cuttings, etc.): e.g. Gas, Oil, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Signal Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of data signal.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Snap Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: When snapping to the Seismic Event Type the application should snap to the Largest or Closest (Valid only for peak or trough)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Solution Gas Oil Ratio Correlation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Model used to compute gas solubility in oil

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Structural Dip Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: This property specifies whether the structural dip is constant, variable or contemporaneous.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Structural Model Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Structural hypothesis chosen to derive the cross section

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Subsea Equipment Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of subsea equipment installed in facility or used in activity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface-Surface Intersection Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of Surface-Surface intersection showing the types of the 2 intersecting surfaces.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of an Earth surface in the subsurface Earth structure, e.g. Fault, Horizon, Boundary, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Screen Arrangment
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Position of the screens, such as in a shale shaker.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tube Upset Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Type of upset in tube or body

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tubular String Component Connection Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The string tubular equipment connection number that is at the top. Allowed values are: UNKNOWN, 1st connection, and 2nd connection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tubular String Component Location Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The location of the super tubular equipment where the sub tubular equipment is attached. Allowed values are: UNKNOWN, attached outside of super string equipment, and attached inside of super string equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tubular Type
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The type of a Tubular used in some activity or installed in and part of the well structure, e.g. Casing, Production Tubing, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Unknown
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Unknown property type; used to assert that a specific Property Code cannot be determined from the information provided.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Synthetic Seismic Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An artificial seismic section produced by collecting artificially-generated traces (such as a Synthetic_Seismogram from log-derived Reflectivity) or by extracting data from an actual seismic section.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Synthetic Seismogram
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: An artificial seismic reflection record produced by assuming a particular wavelet and model. Commonly, a one dimensional synthetic seismogram is generated by convolving a typical seismic wavelet with log-derived Reflectivity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tape Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tape density, usually expressed in bits per inch.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Third Party Design Certification
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Certification by third party for the sampling bottle

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tool Control
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Property that controls the state or operation of a tool.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trajectory
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A description of the path that some activity or object makes as it traverses a medium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: CCP Trajectory
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: List linking shots and receivers to Common Conversion Points (CCP) in depth. Defines the trajectory in shot-offset domain to stack along to image a point in depth.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Alpha Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gradient factor a for Faust 6th root velocity function v(z) = a * z**(1/6)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Beta Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gradient factor b for Faust 3rd root velocity function. v(z) = b * z**(1/3)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gamma Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gradient factor g for Faust Nth root velocity function v(z) = g * z**(1/n)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vitrinite Reflectance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The optical reflectivity of solid organic constituents of rock, known as vitrinite, which provides an indication of thermal maturity.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: VSP waveform Header
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The waveform header used in Vertical Seismic Profile. The structure of the data is specific to Schlumberger Borehole Seismic applications.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cw
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: (Fracturing) Measure of the capability of a fluid flowing in front of a porous media to build up a filter cake inhibiting the fluid leakoff through the porous media. Non RPP66 unit :length/(time)**1/2 e.g. ft/min**1/2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wettability Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Relative affinity of a mineral surface for hydrophilic (water wet) or hydrophobic fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Wettability Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Relative affinity of a mineral surface for oil. Amott

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Wettability Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Relative affinity of a mineral surface for water.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data_Compression_Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Data compression rate between uncompressed data size and compressed data size

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluorescence
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the emission of visible light by a substance that has absorbed light of a differing wavelength.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Relative Fluorescence
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of fluorescence of a material relative to that of some standard.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fraction

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrocarbon Rock Mass Fraction
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the mass of hydrocarbons per rock mass

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Depth Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Change of depth versus distance

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Logarithmic Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The logarithmic expression of permeability usually used in petroleum systems models with a wide range of permeability values

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maturity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measured maturity indicator in source rocks for calibration of petroleum systems

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Battery Charge
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Battery Charge

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cation Exchange Capacity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the extent to which a substance will supply exchange cations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cation Concentration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The concentration of cations, the positively charged particles, in volume of material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrical Stability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of the emulsion stability and oil-wetting capability in oil based drilling fluids.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrochemical Potential
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The component of the Spontaneous or Self Potential comprised of the sum of the liquid-junction and the shale-membrane potentials, both of which are related to ratio of the activity of the formation water to that of the mud filtrate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrokinetic/Streaming Potential
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A voltage which results from the flow of a fluid containing ions. A component of the Spontaneous or Self Potential.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Voltage
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum Voltage

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Min Voltage
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum Voltage

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spontaneous Potential
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The potential difference (DC voltage) between a movable electrode in the borehole and a distant reference electrode usually at surface. The voltage is due to currents generated by the Electrochemical and Electrokinetic potentials.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Attenuation Gain
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Change in electric potential per unit of attenuation, where attenuation is generally expressed in dB.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electric Field Strength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force per unit charge (or voltage gradient).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrical Potential Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Electric potential difference per unit of length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spontaneous Potential Drift
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The drift in the measured Spontaneous Potential per depth.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Impedance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of the ability of an object or medium to resist the flow of electric current. Impedance is a complex quantity composed of a real term (Resistance) and an imaginary term (Reactance).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reactance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The opposition to alternating current flow offered by inductance or capacitance; the quadrature component of impedance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Capacitive Reactance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The component of electrical impedance due to capacitance: Xc = 1 /(2 pi F C), where F is the frequency and C is the capacitance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inductive Reactance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The component of electrical impedance due to inductance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electric Resistance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The resistance of a medium to the flow of electric current; the real component of the complex quantity Impedance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electric Resistance Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the change in electric resistance per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Torque
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Something that produces rotation or torsion and whose effectiveness is measured by the product of the force and the perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the axis of rotation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Downhole Torque
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Downhole torque, as applied to the drill string

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drillstring Drive Torque
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Torque applied to the drillstring, measured at the rotary table or top-drive.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Torsional Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum torque which can be applied to an object without causing permanent deformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection Torsional Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum torque which can be applied to the joint/connection/thread without causing permanent deformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tube Torsional Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum torque which can be applied to the tube or body without causing permanent deformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Energy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Energy of an acoustic wave, calculated as the sum of the squares of the amplitudes of the elements in a wavelet, sometimes multiplied by a proportionality constant.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Energy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Energy of seismic trace within window, computed by summing the squares of the amplitude values and dividing by the number of samples summed.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Enthalpy
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The internal energy of a thermodynamic system plus the product of its pressure and volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heat Quantity
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Energy that causes substances to rise in temperature, fuse, evaporate, expand, or undergo any of various other related changes.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Latent Heat Of Vaporization
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amount of thermal energy required to convert an unit mass of liquid at its boiling point to completely vapor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Energy Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amount of energy per unit volume

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Calorific Value
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amount of heat released during the combustion of a specified amount of a specific substance.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reservoir Energy Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Reservoir energy density

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The rate at which mud, or drilling fluid, is being pumped into, or output from, a borehole or some storage unit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud Pump Maximum Output
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mud pump maximum output, measured in terms of the rate of amount or mud output.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Lab_Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Low fluid flowrate, as used for laboratory experiments

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: LabFlowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Low fluid flowrate, as used for laboratory experiments

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Downhole_Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fluid flowrate at downhole conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: DownholeFlowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fluid flowrate at downhole conditions.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of gas

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Gas Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum gas flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Gas Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum gas flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Gas Capacity of Separator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas separator capacity at maximum working pressure and 1 minute retention time at low liquid level (MMscf/day)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Flowrate at Surface
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas flowrate (surface conditions)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellhead Gas Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas flowrate at the Wellhead

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Flowrate Per Number Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized gas flowrate per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: GasFlowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Air Supply Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The flowrate value which the air supply should be able to achieve

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Time Average Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average Flowrate on a given period of time

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Absolute Delta Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Absolute value of Delta Flow Rate. Calculated from the flowrate data contained in the Flow History, i.e., Q(associated Flow Period) - Q(previous Flow Period).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cementing Unit Max Output
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cementing unit maximum output flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Circulation Loss Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of loss of drilling fluid to the formation, due to mud density exceeding formation fracture pressure gradient, and/or to drilling through a highly permeable formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Condensate Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of condensate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hydrocarbon Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of hydrocarbons (oil, gas and condensate)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inlet Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flow Rate at the inlet of an equipment (e.g. suction side of a pump)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of liquid.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Liquid Capacity of Separator
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Liquid separator capacity at maximum working pressure and 1 minute retention time at high liquid level

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wellhead Liquid Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Liquid flowrate at the Wellhead

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Flowrate Per Number Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized liquid flowrate per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Allowable Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum allowable flowrate for the equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Min Allowable Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum allowable flowrate for the equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal Flow Rate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of oil

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Flowrate at Separator Conditions
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Oil flowrate at separator conditions when a sample is taken

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Flowrate at Surface
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Oil flowrate (surface conditions)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Flowrate at Standard Conditions
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Oil flow rate at standard condition when a sample is taken

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Flowrate Per Number Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized oil flowrate per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Oil Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum oil flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Oil Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum oil flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Sum of the flowrates coming from different sources

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flowrate at End of Transient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flowrate at Transient End Time (qend)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Flowrate at Start of Transient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Flowrate at start of Transient

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Treating Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total flowrate pumped downhole in a well treatment activity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Rate of flow of water

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Flowrate Per Number Of Fractures
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized water  flowrate per number of fractures

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Water Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum water flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Water Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum water flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Flowrate at Surface
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water flowrate (surface conditions)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reservoir Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Reservoir flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pump Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Fluid flowrate through a pump such as an electric submersible pump (ESP).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Carbon Dioxide Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Carbon dioxide flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nitrogen Flowrate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nitrogen flowrate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Per Geologic Time
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Volume per geologic time. E.g. which volume of hydrocarbons were generated in a particular time frame

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Integrated Mobility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The product of thickness and mobility of a permeable medium.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Productivity Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Ratio of flow rate to pressure drop. For oil wells, PI is normally expressed in barrels per day per psi decline in bottomhole flowing pressure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Productivity Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas productivity index

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid Productivity Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Liquid productivity index

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reservoir Liquid Productivity Index
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Reservoir Liquid productivity index

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bending Moment Per Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: For a rotating body, the product of force and length of angular displacement normalized for the radius of rotation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Compressive Force
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force tending to compress or squeeze a body.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drag
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: In drilling, the extra force needed to move the drillstem resulting from the drillstem being in contact with the borehole wall.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The load (down or up) exerted on some object; e.g., hook load.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Down Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum down load for an equipment item such as a drilling jar (lower limit of shock/cushion load.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Lift Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum lift load

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Net Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Weight Indicator load minus any extra equipment weight (Injector head, Hook...)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stripper Friction Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of friction between the coiled tubing and the packoff assembly. It is not the hydraulic pressure within the Stripper.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Up Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Upward load exerted on an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Variable Deck Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Current temporary load on the rig deck

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weight Indicator Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Weight indication as measured at the sensor. In a coiled tubing unit, the sensor is located at the base of the injector head.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Down Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Downward load exerted on an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hook Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The downward force exerted on the hook of the traveling block by the suspended equipment (drillstring, casing, etc.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pickup Hook Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Driller estimate of the average pickup hook load (pickup weight) over the reporting period.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rotating Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Surface weight of the drillstring while drilling

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Slackoff Hook Load
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average slackoff hook load (slackoff weight) over the reporting period.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Up Pull
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum up pull for an equipment item, such as drilling jars (upper limit of shock/cushion load).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pad Force
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tool pad force

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Restoring Force
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force required to restore initial conditions. For example, at the end of a test.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Running Force
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force needed to run. For example, during a test.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Setting Force
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Load which must be applied to set compression type packer. Typical value : 10,000 lbf

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Starting Force
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force applied at the start of a process. For example, at the beginning of a test.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force tending to cause extension of a body, as experienced in a cable, rope, string, etc.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Anchor Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tension of the anchor chains or cables of a marine vessel; may be implemented as a vector.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Downhole Cable Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tension of the logging cable as measured at the top of the logging tool

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum tension

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pickup Reel Back Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of tension kept on the coiled tubing between the gooseneck and the reel when pulling out of the hole

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Riser Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tension of the marine riser

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Slackoff Reel Back Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of tension kept on the coiled tubing between the gooseneck and the reel while going into the hole

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Cable Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tension of the logging cable as measured at the surface.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tensile Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum force which can be applied to an object without causing permanent deformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection Tensile Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum force which can be applied to a joint/connection/thread without causing permanent deformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tube Tensile Yield
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum Force which can be applied to a tube or body without causing permanent deformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The force with which a body is attracted toward the center of the earth or any celestial body by gravitation. The product of the mass of the body by the local gravitational acceleration.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weight Per Joint
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Weight of each joint in a string of equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Approximate Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: API approximate weight of one section

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Nominal Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: API nominal weight of tube with joint for drill pipe and casing pipe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Battery Weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cutter Set Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Approximate weight of the set of cutters

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Approximate weight joint/connection 1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 Approximate Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Approximate weight joint/connection 2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Weight of the injector head of a coiled tubing unit

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Module Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Module Weight

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Weight
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) weight of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weight On Bit
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The downward force exerted by the drillbit on the formation being drilled.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Average Weight On Bit
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average "Weight On Bit" (WOB)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Max Weight On Bit
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum weight on bit

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Spring Stiffness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient relating spiral spring exerted force and corresponding elongation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: SpringStiffness
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient relating spiral spring exerted force and corresponding elongation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Surface tension

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Surface Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Surface tension

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interfacial Tension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The tension between two interfaces; e.g., light and heavy fluid phases, gas-liquid, gas-oil, gas-water. Also called surface tension or surface tensity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of bits that may be transported, say via telemetry, per unit time.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Count Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The number of events per unit time; e.g. the output of a scintillation counters.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stroke Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Frequency of the piston (plunger) of a pump usually expressed in number of strokes per minute

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acquisition Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Channel acquisition rate: number of data samples acquired per unit of time

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Band High Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Upper limit of frequency band (range)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Band Low Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Lower limit of frequency band (range)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bandwidth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective frequency range, typically between the half-power points (the frequencies at which the power drops to half of the peak power). Bandwidth is occasionally represented by the central frequency of the band or as the difference between the lower and upper limits of the frequency band, but generally the absolute frequencies should be specified, such as by using Band_Low/High_Frequency properties or by using a complex value type with the Bandwidth property.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bandwidth Rating Bias
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Statistical estimation of bandwidth of data within window. Aids in determining appropriate spectral operators for subsequent operations. Computation: Let the autocorrelation of the trace be A[i]. Then compute M = max(A) and S = sum(A[i]**2). The bandwidth rating bias B is then : B = M**2 / r(2 S - M**2), where r is the sample rate.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bandwidth Rating Debias
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Statistical estimation of bandwidth of data within window. The bandwidth rating debias D is computed from the bandwidth rating bias B as follows: D = 5/3 B - 1/(s*n), where n is the number of sampled used in the computation. Generally more stable than Bandwidth_Rating_Bias, unless window is small.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Baud Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The net speed at which data are transmitted.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Central Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Central frequency within power spectrum; average of the low and high frequencies of the band.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Compressional Velocity Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the change in the compressional velocity of a medium per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dominant Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Predominant frequency within power spectrum.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Instantaneous Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Time derivative of Instantaneous_Amplitude.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Response Frequency
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Instantaneous frequency at local maximum of reflection intensity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shear Velocity Gradient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the change in the shear velocity of a medium per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shock Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measure of shocks or vibrations above some threshold per unit of time; used to quantify vibration severity for MWD/LWD tools.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Velocity Gradient In Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: First derivative of velocity versus depth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: K Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Velocity depth gradient, dv/dz used in some velocity functions like linear velocity : v(z) = v_0 + k*z depth of burial : v(z,z_1) = v_0 + k_1*z_1 + k_2*(z-z_1)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas to Liquid Ratio Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Gas to liquid ratio rate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Liquid to Gas Ratio Rate
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Liquid to gas ratio rate

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Frequency Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The Frequency Factor is the pre-exponential factor of the Arrhenius equation describing the frequency of collisions between reactant molecules

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Generation Rate Per Geologic Time
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Describes the generation of hydrocarbons from kerogen in dependency to geologic time

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mass Fraction Per Geologic Time
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The mass per mass versus geologic time. E.g. the generated mass of hydrocarbons per rock mass per million years

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Volume Rate Per Volume
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The volume per volume in geologic time. E.g. The volume of generated hydrocarbons of a volume of source rock in a geologic timeframe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Heat Transfer Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of heat transferred per unit time per degree per unit area.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inductance Per Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Usually called Magnetic Permeability

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Magnetic Permeability
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The three-dimensional inductance of a material, a measure of the magnetic induction produced in a material by a given magnetic field strength. Free space (and nonmagnetic rock) has a permeability of 1.257*10-6 henrys/meter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stretch Coefficient
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The amount of stretch per unit force applied.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Capture Cross Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The effective area within which a neutron passes in order to be captured by an atomic nucleus. Commonly called Sigma.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Borehole Neutron Capture Cross Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The macroscopic neutron capture cross section, i.e. the effective cross sectional area per unit volume, of the borehole environment; used to correct "Sigma" log measurements for borehole effects.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Matrix Neutron Capture Cross Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The macroscopic capture cross section, i.e. the effective cross-sectional area per unit volume, of the rock matrix for the capture of neutrons.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Neutron Capture Cross Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The macroscopic capture cross section, i.e. the effective cross sectional area per unit volume, of water for the capture of neutrons.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Attenuation Factor
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Coefficient used to quantify the attenuation of a plane wave: a wave traveling a distance X will be reduced by a factor of e**(-AX), where A is attenuation factor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of fracture occurrence, often measured as a function of linear trace length of fractures observed in a given surface area.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: MWD Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed; may be expressed as samples per unit length or as a Boolean indicator of sample presence within a depth frame.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a neutron logging measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a nuclear magnetism measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Resistivity Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a resistivity logging measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Sonic Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a sonic logging measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for an temperature measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a toolface measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for an annular pressure measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a bulk density logging measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gamma Ray Data Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Density of data samples per length of borehole traversed, for a gamma ray logging measurement.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Shot Density
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The perforation density; i.e., the number of shots per unit length.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Specific Surface Area
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characteristic of a porous media which is the internal surface area of the medium per unit volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Specific Surface Area (volume-based)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The characteristic of a porous media which is the internal surface area of the medium per unit volume.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wavenumber
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Spatial frequency, reciprocal of wavelength

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bandwidth Rating Bias Wavenumber
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bandwidth rating bias in depth domain. See Bandwidth_Rating_Bias

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bandwidth Rating Debias Wavenumber
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bandwidth rating debias in depth domain. See Bandwidth_Rating_Debias

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Central Wavenumber
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Central frequency in the depth domain

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dominant Wavenumber
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Dominant Wavenumber in depth domain. Reciprocal of distance between successive peaks or troughs.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Instantaneous Wavenumber
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Instantaneous frequency measured in depth domain

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Neutron Scatter Cross Section
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The effective area within which a neutron passes in order to be scattered by an atomic nucleus

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mud_Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mud Compressibility

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: MudCompressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Mud Compressibility

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The change in specific volume and density under pressure; the reciprocal of Bulk Modulus, 1/k.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Isothermal Gas Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Change in gas volume per unit volume per change in pressure (dV/V.dp) at a given pressure and temperature.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Matrix Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The compressibility of a homogeneous solid material.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Isothermal Oil Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The compressibility of oil at a given pressure and temperature.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pore Volume Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The relative change in the pore volume of a rock under conditions of changing confining pressure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Produced Fluid Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Compressibility of the Total Produced Fluid for the Hydraulic Unit. It is corrected from Reservoir_Fluid_Compressibility by taking into account the actual volume fractions produced based on the saturation of the fluid within the reservoir.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reservoir Fluid Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Compressibility of the reservoir fluid

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rock Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Compressibility of the rock matrix.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Compressibility of the rock matrix combined with fluid compressibilities within the matrix.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Isothermal Water Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The compressibility of water at a given pressure and temperature.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Compliance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The relationship of strain to stress, a tensor quantity expressible as the inverse of the stiffness matrix.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Viscosibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized derivative of viscosity: -(dv/dp)/v where v=viscosity and p=pressure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Viscosibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Normalized derivative of viscosity for water: -(dv/dp)/v where v=viscosity and p=pressure.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oilfield_Gauge_Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Used for data traditionally measured in "1/32 in"

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: OilfieldGaugeLength
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Used for data traditionally measured in "1/32 in"

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Visibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum distance at which objects can still be discerned or identified visually.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Axial Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The length associated with the longest dimension of an object. This corresponds to the height of a cylinder, or the longest axis of a rectangle.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Axial Spacing
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The spacing or distance between two locations on an equipment item; for example, between two sensors on a logging tool.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cable Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Cable length; measured from a fixed reference point and used as Measured Depth in Wireline operations

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bend 1 To Bottom Conn

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bend 2 To Bottom Conn

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Landing Collar depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measured depth of the collar on which the cement plugs seat : this data is required to compute the displacement volume of a cementing operation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Last Static Pressure Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth at which last reservoir pressure data were recorded

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Map Migrated Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth obtained through map migration of time surface data

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum Depth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Measured Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth measured along the borehole path from the working datum.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Planned Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The planned measured depth at the end of the reporting period, as described on the driller depth log of the planned borehole

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum Depth of Activity

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Cable Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal cable depth, such as that planned for the receiver cable in a marine seismic survey.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Source Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Planned depth for the source

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Packer Measured Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth at which the packer is set.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Depth of Penetration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth to which some medium is penetrated, such as by a drill bit or probe, or by fluid invasion. (Not to be used for borehole depth.)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil-Water Contact Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The depth at which oil water contact has been recognized in a Reservoir Unit.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Plug Back Total Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measured Depth of the current bottom of the borehole. It is the physical bottom of the borehole which is plugged either by a cement or by a mechanical plug. The P.B.T.D. can changes in time. It is smaller than the total depth drilled.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pool or Pond Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: For a centrifuge, Position of overflow Port relative to Inner Bowl Wall

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Propped Bottom Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bottom Depth of proppant laden slurry volume during the propagation of an hydraulic fracture considered along the well bore..

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Propped Top Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Top Depth of proppant laden slurry during the propagation of an hydraulic fracture considered along the well bore. Often named Slurry height. At fracture closure, Propped_Top_Depth = Fracture_Height.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Reference Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth value used as a reference for other data

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Depth for Rock Compressibility
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Measured depth for which Rock Compressibility is stated.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Standard Reference Datum Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth measured from the Standard Reference Datum

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Start Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth at which an activity starts e.g. at the beginning of the Coiled tubing pumping stage, depth of the cleaning tool

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Stop Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth at which a particular activity stopped.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TST Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The depth of a point relative to a True Stratigraphic Thickness (TST) Index. Such indices may be local to a particular zone interval, hence their values can only be compared to other values referenced to the same index.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top TST Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True Stratigraphic Thickness Depth of Top of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom TST Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True Stratigraphic Thickness Depth of Bottom of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: True Vertical Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The true vertical depth from the surface of the Earth to a particular subsurface point.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top True Vertical Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True Vertical Depth of Top of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom True Vertical Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True Vertical Depth of Bottom of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Depth from SRD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Vertical Depth from Seismic Reference Datum

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Depth from MSL
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Vertical Depth from Mean Sea Level

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top Subsea Vertical Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Subsea Vertical Depth of Top of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom Subsea Vertical Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Subsea Vertical Depth of Bottom of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: TVT Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The depth of a point relative to a True Vertical Thickness (TVT) Index. Such indices may be local to a particular zone interval, hence their values can only be compared to other values referenced to the same index.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top TVT Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True Vertical Thickness Depth of Top of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom TVT Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: True Vertical Thickness Depth of Bottom of Interval

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tubing Shoe Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tubing shoe depth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Test Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth at which a formation test is performed; normally taken to be measured depth.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Top Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The top depth of a borehole interval, a formation or any depth indexed representation of an data item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tracking Depth Window Top
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distance above the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type while tracking

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Snap Depth Window Top
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distance above the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type when snapping

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Survey Top Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Shallowest depth of the survey or suite of surveys.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Total Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The total depth, usually of the well borehole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Driller Total Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The total depth of the well borehole as reported by the drilling contractor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Logger Total Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The total depth of the well borehole as reported by the logging contractor.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Trace Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The depth coordinate of a trace

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Current Total depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth of the borehole at the moment of the treatment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Lift Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Tubing depth in vertical lift fluid flow computation

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Water depth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weathering Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth of the weathered layer, the near-surface low velocity layer consisting of unconsolidated material and rock in which air rather than water fills the pore space.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Weathering Depth at CDP
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth of weathered layer at a CDP.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zone Start
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The start depth of a zone, usually along the borehole. This may be the deeper or the shallower end of the zone.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Zone Stop
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The stop depth of a zone, usually along the borehole. This may be the deeper or the shallower end of the zone.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth of the drillbit

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bottom Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The deepest depth of a borehole interval, a formation, or any depth indexed representation of a data item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rat Hole Bottom Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Bottom depth of the section of the borehole running from the tester valve to the effective bottom of the well

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Snap Depth Window Bottom
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distance below the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type when snapping

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Survey Bottom Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Deepest depth to which the borehole was surveyed

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tracking Depth Window Bottom
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distance below the picked Z to search for the Event_Type and Snap_Type while tracking

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing Shoe Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Casing shoe depth

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Circulation Loss Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth at which circulation is being lost to the formation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Corrected Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth which can be offset and scaled from the raw depth acquired from a sensor to take into account the position or deformation of the sensor thus the name of corrected.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Depth Offset
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Offset in depth versus some depth reference.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Depth Offset
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Offset in true vertical depth versus some true vertical depth reference.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length from one side of an object to the other measured along a straight line through the center of the object

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Differential Caliper
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The difference between the actual borehole diameter and bit size.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Line Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the gas line

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gas Metering Line Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Line size of gas meter inlet and outlet pipe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Grain Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average diameter of a mineral grain or set of grains.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Horizontal Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The size of any object as measured horizontally

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inside Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inside diameter of an entity, such as an item of drillstring equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Casing ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum inside diameter of casing for which service or equipment is suitable

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Manifold Choke Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum inner diameter of the choke orifice

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Casing ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum inside diameter of casing for which service or equipment is suitable

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum inside diameter of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) inside diameter of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tube Nominal ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal inside diameter of body or actual inside diameter tube (for API spec. drill pipe)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: External Pipe Inside Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inside diameter of a pipe in external position within an annulus

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Packer ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Packer internal diameter (Casing_Tubing Packer)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pass-Through Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Equipment (e.g. drillbit) attribute which specifies the minimum inside diameter of casing through which the equipment will pass.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pipe ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inside diameter of pipe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rat Hole Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the section of the borehole running from the tester valve to the effective bottom of the well

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Riser ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The internal diameter of the marine riser.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Valve Inside Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inside diameter of the valve assembly

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bore Inside Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The inside diameter of the equipment bore.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Borehole Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The inside diameter of a borehole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electrical Penetration
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The apparent borehole diameter as viewed by electrical measurements

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Borehole Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum borehole diameter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Borehole Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum borehole diameter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bit Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal inside diameter of a borehole; often referred to a "bit size".

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Caliper
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Borehole diameter as measured by a logging device: a record of the borehole or the internal diameter of tubular goods.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Density Caliper
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Borehole diameter as estimated by a density logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Electromagnetic Caliper
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Borehole diameter as estimated by an electromagnetic logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Ultrasonic Caliper
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Borehole diameter as measured by an ultrasonic logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Washout Caliper Difference
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The degree of a borehole ovality beyond which caliper data becomes unreliable due to bad contact with the tool pads.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Washout Caliper Extension
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The extension of a borehole diameter beyond which caliper data becomes unreliable due to bad contact with the tool pads.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Acoustic Caliper
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Borehole diameter as estimated by an acoustic logging device.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Casing inner diameter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Choke Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Internal diameter of the flow choke(s)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 1 ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inside diameter of tool joint/connection 1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Inside diameter of tool joint/connection 2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Drift Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Largest diameter of a perfect cylinder of a specified length that can fit into the pipe. Because a pipe is never perfectly cylindrical but slightly oval the drift diameter is always smaller than the quoted inner diameter. The drift diameter is used to know if a given pipe or instrument will run into a pipe.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tube Drift Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drift diameter of tube or body of equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 1 Drift Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drift diameter of tool joint/connection 1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 Drift Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drift diameter of tool joint/connection 2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Effective ID
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Effective inside diameter for stiffness, as used for drilling tools.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Hole Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The effective inside diameter of a Well; may be of the Borehole, Casing or Tubing.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Invasion Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The diameter to which drilling mud filtrate has invaded porous and permeable rock around the borehole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inlet Connection Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The connection size of the input line to the equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Major Axis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of the major (long) axis of an ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Mean Particle Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average diameter of the particle (e.g. for Gravel pack sand 20/40 mean diameter=0 .025 inc/0.635 mm, 40/60 mean diameter=0.014 inch/0.355mm).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minor Axis
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of the minor (short) axis of an ellipse.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) diameter of an object.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nozzle Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the nozzle(s) used in an equipment item, such as a drill bit

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Orifice Plate Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of orifice plate in gas metering system when a sample is taken

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Outlet Connection Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The connection size of the output line to the equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Outside Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Outside diameter of an entity, such as an item of drillstring equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pipe OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Outside diameter of pipe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Shank Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Outer diameter of the equipment shank; for a drill bit, the shank is the portion of the bit body between the threaded connection and the base of the bit leg (for roller cone bits) or bit crown (for fixed cutter bits).

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wire Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of wire, such as that used in a mesh or a slotted liner

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Casing OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Casing outer diameter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Centralizer OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Centralizer outside diameter

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 1 OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Outside diameter of tool joint/connection 1

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 1 Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Size of the top or the first standard tool connection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Outside diameter of tool joint/connection 2

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Connection 2 Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Size of the bottom or second standard tool connection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fishneck Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the fishing neck of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Inner Pipe Outside Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Outer diameter of the inner pipe

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum outside diameter of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal Maximum OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal maximum outside diameter, such as for a pilot hole.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum Compressed OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum compressed outside diameter, such as for a centralizer.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Minimum OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Minimum outside diameter of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Nominal OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) outside diameter of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tube Nominal OD
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Nominal outside diameter of body or API nominal outside diameter of tube

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The diameter of the perforation entrance hole. Often called Entrance Hole Diameter.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Entrance Hole Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Entrance hole diameter in an API Section I test

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Connection Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Standard oil pipe size connection supplied on the equipment inlet

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Oil Metering Line Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the oil metering line

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pore Throat Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measured or effective diameter of the aperture which connects pores or void spaces within a rock matrix.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Port Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of each individual port

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pump Liner Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the pump entry line

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Core Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Drum core diameter, such as for a coiled tubing reel

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Screen Mesh Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Size of the mesh (usually expressed in inches) use to filter particles.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cone Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Largest Inner Diameter of a Cone

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Upset Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Upset diameter (such as replaceable sleeve stabilizer)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Connection Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Standard water pipe size connection supplied on the equipment inlet

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Water Metering Line Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the water metering line

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: API Pin Connection Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: API pin connection size

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Bubble Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Diameter of the bubbles of non-continuous production phase.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Burner Pilot Gas Connection Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Standard gas pipe size connection supplied on the pilot inlet equipment

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Cuttings Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average diameter of drill cuttings.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Core Diameter
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The Diameter of the recovered core.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Displacement
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The linear distance which a point or object is displaced with respect to another, usually as the result of some activity or process.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Displacement
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The measure of the relative movement of the 2 sides of a fault.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Heave
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Horizontal component of separation or displacement on a fault.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geocentric Delta-X
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: X component of the translation of the center of a geodetic datum. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geocentric Delta-Y
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Y component of the translation of the center of a geodetic datum. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Geocentric Delta-Z
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Z component of the translation of the center of a geodetic datum. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Particle Displacement
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The distance a particle is moved from its equilibrium position, as in ground motion associated with a seismic wave.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: X Direction Displacement
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Displacement in the X Direction relative to some coordinate system; e.g., the X-Component of the Well departure from the vertical.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Y Direction Displacement
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Displacement in the Y Direction relative to some coordinate system; e.g., the Y-Component of the Well departure from the vertical.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Distance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amount of separation between two points, lines, surfaces, or objects measured along the shortest path joining them.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Eccentering
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: A measure of the amount by which an object is off-center with respect to another; e.g. the displacement between the axis of a logging tool and the borehole axis.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Energy Half Depth
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Depth, within a specified interval, at which half the energy of the interval occurs

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Etched Half Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Half Length of formation etched (dissolved) by reaction with acid (Acid fracturing)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fishneck Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of the fishing neck of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facture Half Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The length of one wing of a fracture, from the bore hole to one of its ends.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facture Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The length of one wing of a fracture.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: From Offset
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The distance from the mid-point of the "From" equipment to the bottom of the "To" equipment in a From_To connection.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Gauge Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of the in-gauge portion of an equipment item.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The distance from the bottom to the top of something standing upright. Also, the extent of elevation above a level.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Leakoff Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Portion of the zone fracturing fluids will leakoff into. It can be an aggregate of a number of geologic formations.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perspective Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of the point of perspective; used in general perspective map projections.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Rig Heave
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Amplitude of the vertical motion of the rig

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Maximum Rig Heave
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Maximum amplitude of the vertical motion of the rig

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Proppant Bank Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of the settled bank of proppant within a fracture, otherwise named pack height.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Vertical Size
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The size of any object as measured vertically

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Wave Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Average trough-to-peak height of the waves.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Altitude
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height above a reference level, such as mean sea level.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Capillary Transition Zone Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The vertical interval height that describes the transition between two different fluid phases in a porous media. This transition is caused by changes in saturation dependent capillary forces in equilibrium with gravitational forces.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Dip Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of Dip Plane Intersection with Borehole

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Elevation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of some point above a horizontal reference plane.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Elevation at CDP
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Surface elevation at a CDP with respect to mean sea level.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Return Elevation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Elevation of the drill fluid return line measured from the defined elevation reference datum (normally kelly bushing or rig floor). Note that if the elevation is negative, the return line is below the elevation reference datum.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Receiver Station Datum Elevation
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Datum elevation at each station relative to sea level

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fault Throw
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of the vertical displacement of a Fault.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fill Up Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of unwanted material (formation sand, proppant, gravel pack failure, workover debris ...) filling up the wellbore

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fluid Level
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The level of fluid in a column or vessel, normally expressed as height above (or below) some reference point.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Fracture Element Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of fracture element

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Facture Height
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Height of a fracture.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Horizontal Well Flowing Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Total Horizontal Well Flowing Length

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Interval Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The length of an interval along a path, such as a Borehole path.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Material Addition Depth Increment
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The depth increment at which the material addition takes place (e.g., Add 5 sacks of Barite C100 100lb/sack to the drilling fluid each 500 ft)

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Pattern Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The length of a pattern, usually pertaining to a dip pattern or a geological feature. The length is usually an interval length like depth.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Perforation Distance
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Distance from the top of the hydraulic unit to the top of the perforations. For use in the partial penetration model.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Processing Window Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of processing window

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Window Length (Depth)
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of processing window in depth domain

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Segment Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: The length of a borehole segment.

ListOfChildMeasurements.Name: Tracking Depth Operator Length
ListOfChildMeasurements.Description: Length of the cross correlation window to use while tracking
